AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了定量证据，表明提升女性劳动力参与率并与识字率及教育投资相结合可以成为促进经济增长的重要政策杠杆，尤其对南方邦等区域具有更强的政策意义。

title: An Efficiency Analysis of Public Sectors of OECD Countries

detail.title: An Efficiency Analysis of Public Sectors of OECD Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study used secondary, publicly available country-level data and did not involve human participants or the collection of identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency.

publicationDetails.detailsText: M.Phil Thesis, School of Economics, Bahauddin Zakariya University Multan, Session 2014–2016.

A portion of this thesis was developed into the published article “Efficiency of Working Governments: A Case Study of 27 OECD Countries” (Javed, 2023). The thesis predates the article and contains the broader research framework and analysis.

detail.abstract: The study is conducted in order to measure the efficiency of 22 OECD countries by taking data of seven years from 2008-2014. The analysis is conducted by taking three input variables education spending, health spending and social spending. All three input variables are taken as percentage of GDP. Output variables include life expectancy at birth, Infant Survival Rate (ISR), 25-34 years old population with tertiary education, unemployment rate and Corruption index. DEA is employed to measure the technical efficiency of the selected DMUs under the assumptions of CRS and VRS and then Scale efficiency is calculated. There are 9 countries on the frontier under CRS while France is the least efficient one. Total efficiency under CRS is 94%. Under VRS 15 countries are on the frontier and the least efficient one is Belgium. Total efficiency under VRS is 97%. Switzerland is the least efficient country under Scale efficiency and there are 9 countries on the frontier. Total Scale Efficiency is 97%. Then second stage analysis is conducted in order to separately analyze the European and Non-European countries by taking VRS efficiency scores as dependent variable and the independent variables include GDP per capita growth rate, Government Stability, Income Inequality, Labor Force Participation rate (between 15-64 years), Human development Index (HDI) and one Dummy variable that take 1 for Non-European and 0 for European countries. The second stage analysis shows a significant positively related impact of GDP Per Capita Growth Rate and Government Stability over efficiency. Income inequality is negatively related and statistically significant while HDI is insignificant statistically as it is a combination variable. All the results for truncated regression are calculated at 95% confidence interval.

AI.tldr: 本文运用DEA方法测量了22个OECD国家2008-2014年间在教育、医疗和社会支出方面的技术效率，并采用截断回归进行第二阶段分析，探讨影响效率的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 22个OECD国家在公共服务支出方面的技术效率如何？哪些社会经济因素影响其效率水平？
AI.motivation: 评估OECD国家公共支出的效率，识别高效率和低效率国家，并探究效率差异的驱动因素，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据包络分析（DEA）理论，包括CRS和VRS假设下的技术效率测度，以及规模效率（Scale Efficiency）概念。
AI.method: 采用DEA方法在CRS和VRS假设下测量技术效率，计算规模效率；第二阶段采用截断回归（Truncated Regression）分析，以VRS效率分数为因变量，探究GDP人均增长率、政府稳定性、收入不平等、劳动力参与率、人类发展指数（HDI）及欧洲/非欧洲虚拟变量对效率的影响。
AI.findings: CRS下9个国家处于前沿，法国效率最低，总体效率94%；VRS下15个国家处于前沿，比利时效率最低，总体效率97%；规模效率下9个国家处于前沿，瑞士效率最低，总体规模效率97%。GDP人均增长率和政府稳定性与效率显著正相关；收入不平等与效率显著负相关；HDI统计上不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将DEA与截断回归方法结合应用于OECD国家公共支出效率研究，验证了效率影响因素的理论假设，丰富了效率评估领域的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为OECD国家提供效率基准比较，识别低效率国家（如法国、比利时、瑞士）的改进空间，并指出经济增长和政府稳定性对提升效率的重要性，为公共政策制定提供参考。

title: Formation and Fragility

detail.title: Formation and Fragility
detail.abstract: Vendor finance can both relax customer financing constraints and create the links along which distress later propagates. Existing trade-credit theory explains why bilateral contracts form, while financial-network theory studies amplification on a given network. We study formation and propagation in one contract economy. Contracts occupy a typed undirected network. Conditional on a regular agreement stratum, economically executable configurations form a manifold with corners. Parties choose legal architectures summarized by six functional channels. Agreement-compatible dynamics generate a forward-invariant productive region; reduction to a funding–technology observable yields a directed operator JT F = −R + W. Direction is therefore derived from the contract system after an observable is chosen. On the cooperative subclass W ≥ 0, the normalized amplification A = ρ(R−1W) separates locally stable productive operation from propagation fragility. Signed cross-effects instead admit an exact two-state determinant test and a conservative absolute-value comparison bound. Because A depends on the selected architecture, contract design moves the boundary. Privately optimal architectures generally do not internalize their marginal contribution to A. We characterize the resulting wedge and resilient redesigns that lower A while preserving productive function. We also give a rank condition for identifying the six channels and state conditional data requirements for applying it. This paper conducts no systematic filing audit and estimates neither the six-channel profile nor A; narrower implications remain testable with executed-contract or supervisory data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了供应商融资（vendor finance）网络的形成与风险传播的一体化经济模型。在合同经济中，合同占据一个带类型标记的无向网络，可执行配置构成带角的流形。通过六个功能渠道概括法律架构，作者导出一个有向算子 J^T F = −R + W，并定义了归一化放大系数 A = ρ(R⁻¹W)，用于区分局部稳定的生产运行与传播脆弱性。文章还刻画了私有最优架构与边际放大贡献之间的楔形差距，并提出降低A同时保持生产功能的韧性重设计。
AI.research_question: 在单一合同经济中，供应商融资网络的形成（合同设计）与风险传播（违约放大）如何内生地相互决定？
AI.motivation: 现有贸易信贷理论解释了双边合同为何形成，金融网络理论研究了给定网络上的风险放大，但两者割裂——缺少一个统一框架同时解释合同的形成（网络内生性）与传播（网络上的动态）如何相互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易信贷理论、金融网络理论、合同设计理论、具有角点的流形几何、合同兼容动力系统、有向算子谱分析与谱半径放大指标
AI.method: 构建一个合同经济模型，合同占据带类型标记的无向网络；在给定规则协议层面下，可执行配置构成带角的流形；将法律架构概括为六个功能渠道；推导合同兼容动力系统，化为资金-技术可观测量的有向算子 J^T F = −R + W；对合作子类 W ≥ 0 用归一化放大 A = ρ(R⁻¹W) 分析稳定性；对符号交叉效应给出精确两态行列式检验与保守绝对值比较界；并通过秩条件说明六个渠道的识别。
AI.findings: (1) 方向性在合同系统中选择可观测量后派生出来；(2) 合作子类上，A = ρ(R⁻¹W) 将局部稳定生产运行与传播脆弱性分离；(3) 合同设计可以移动 A 的边界，但私有最优架构通常不内部化其对 A 的边际贡献，产生楔形差距；(4) 存在降低 A 同时保持生产功能的韧性重设计；(5) 给出识别六个渠道的秩条件及数据要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将贸易信贷理论的合同形成与金融网络理论的传播分析统一到同一合同经济中，通过有向算子和谱放大指标把合同设计与系统性风险联系起来，提出了合同设计的系统性外部性概念（楔形差距），并给出了韧性重设计的理论刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者和从业者提供了评估供应商融资合同中风险放大效应的分析框架；给出了识别六个功能渠道的秩条件与数据要求，便于使用已执行合同或监管数据进行经验检验；提供了在保持生产功能的同时降低传播脆弱性的合同重设计方案。

title: Self-powered Event-driven Intelligent Surface for Waste Classification via TENG-triggered Vision and ConvNeXt Learning
affiliations: Lanzhou University, Chengdu University of Information Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Electronic Science and  Technology of China, University of Electronic Science and  Technology of China, Lanzhou University - School of Physical Science and Technology and University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC) - School of Physics

detail.title: Self-powered Event-driven Intelligent Surface for Waste Classification via TENG-triggered Vision and ConvNeXt Learning
detail.abstract: Intelligent waste classification systems are often constrained by the high energy cost of continuous sensing and vision processing. Herein, we report a self-powered intelligent surface that integrates a triboelectric nanogenerator (TENG) with an event-driven machine learning framework for autonomous waste classification. The TENG functions as a tactile interface that converts disposal actions into electrical signals, enabling on-demand activation of image acquisition and recognition only upon physical interaction. This event-driven architecture eliminates continuous sensing and significantly reduces system energy consumption. Coupled with a ConvNeXt-based vision model, the system achieves accurate multi-category waste identification under realistic conditions. The TENG sensor exhibits stable output and fast dynamic response, ensuring reliable triggering in practical environments. This work establishes a self-powered, event-driven paradigm for intelligent environmental sensing, offering an energy-efficient pathway toward next-generation autonomous waste management systems.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种自供能智能表面系统，将摩擦电纳米发电机（TENG）与事件驱动的机器学习框架相结合，用于自主垃圾分类。该系统通过TENG作为触觉界面，仅在物理交互时按需触发图像采集和识别，消除了连续感测的能耗，并结合ConvNeXt视觉模型实现高精度多类别垃圾分类。
AI.research_question: 如何解决传统智能垃圾分类系统因连续感测和视觉处理导致的高能耗问题？
AI.motivation: 现有智能垃圾分类系统依赖于持续的传感和视觉处理，能耗高昂，限制了其在实际环境中的大规模部署和应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 摩擦电纳米发电机（TENG）自供能传感原理、事件驱动计算架构、深度学习视觉识别（ConvNeXt模型）。
AI.method: 将TENG作为触觉传感器集成到智能表面，通过物理交互产生电信号触发图像采集；采用事件驱动架构按需激活识别流程；使用ConvNeXt视觉模型进行多类别垃圾分类识别。
AI.findings: 该系统TENG传感器输出稳定且具有快速动态响应，能确保在实际环境中可靠触发；结合ConvNeXt视觉模型，在现实条件下实现了准确的多类别垃圾分类识别；事件驱动架构消除了连续感测，显著降低了系统能耗。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了自供能、事件驱动的智能环境感知范式，为智能垃圾分类系统提供了新的架构设计思路，将能量收集与按需计算相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种节能高效的自主垃圾分类系统方案，为下一代智能废弃物管理系统的实际部署和推广提供了可行路径。

title: From Compliance to Claim: Re-Orienting the EU’s Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment for Patient-Centred AI in Health
affiliations: Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio), Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, Catalan Institution of Research and Advanced Studies (ICREA), Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio) and Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio)

detail.title: From Compliance to Claim: Re-Orienting the EU’s Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment for Patient-Centred AI in Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: nothing to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: nothing to declare

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence offers the potential for faster diagnosis, broader access, and more efficient healthcare delivery across the European Union. However, it also poses risks of reinforcing bias, exclusion, and diminishing patient autonomy. The European Union has responded with a complex array of recent regulatory instruments, including the AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689), the European Health Data Space Regulation (EU) 2025/327, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Medical Device Regulation, the Data Act, and the Data Governance Act. While these instruments are technically advanced, they are primarily structured around system risk, market access, or data flows, rather than focusing on the patient as a rights-holder. In response, this paper proposes a rights-integrated constitutional framework for digital health governance that recenters these instruments on the individual, using the right to health (ICESCR Article 12, as interpreted in CESCR General Comment No. 14) as the central integrating norm. The framework is built on three pillars: accountability, agency, and participation, each anchored in existing legal mechanisms rather than in newly asserted justiciable rights. The principal operational recommendation is to reorient the AI Act's fundamental-rights impact assessment (Article 27) into a patient-facing, contestable entitlement, granting individuals the right to be informed when an assessment is required, to access the assessment, and to challenge deployments that were not adequately anticipated. The contribution of this approach lies in integrating existing entitlements rather than creating additional ones. The framework is situated within an explicit enforceability taxonomy and addresses key objections, including concerns that the proliferation of rights may undermine enforceability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以权利整合为核心的数字健康治理宪法框架，将欧盟复杂的AI与健康数据监管工具重新聚焦于患者个体，以健康权（ICESCR第12条）为中心整合规范，通过问责、代理和参与三大支柱，将AI法案的基本权利影响评估（第27条）转化为面向患者的可争议权利。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟AI与健康数据监管日益复杂的背景下，如何构建一个以患者为权利主体的数字健康治理框架，以克服现有监管工具各自为政、缺乏以人为中心的问题？
AI.motivation: 欧盟现有的AI与健康数据监管工具（AI法案、欧洲健康数据空间条例、GDPR、医疗器械法规、数据法案、数据治理法案）虽技术上先进，但主要以系统风险、市场准入或数据流为导向，忽视了患者作为权利持有者的核心地位。AI在医疗中的应用虽然潜力巨大，但也可能强化偏见、排斥和削弱患者自主权，亟需一个以人为中心的整合性治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以健康权（CESCR第14号一般性意见所解释的ICESCR第12条）作为核心整合规范，构建基于问责（accountability）、代理（agency）和参与（participation）三大支柱的宪法框架，并置于明确的可执行性分类法中。
AI.method: 规范性法学分析与框架构建方法，通过整合欧盟现有监管工具与健康权法律框架，进行跨领域法律分析并提出操作性改革建议。
AI.findings: 提出了一个以权利整合为核心的框架：将AI法案第27条的基本权利影响评估重新定位为面向患者的可争议性权利，赋予个体被告知何时需要进行评估、获取评估内容以及质疑未被充分预见的部署的权利。该方法的贡献在于整合现有权利而非创设新权利，并回应了权利增殖可能削弱可执行性的批评。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了权利整合式数字健康治理宪法框架，将健康权作为整合性规范贯穿欧盟多层次监管工具，填补了现有框架以系统为中心而非以患者为中心的空白；提出通过整合现有权利而非创设新权利来增强治理有效性的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的操作性建议，即将AI法案第27条的基本权利影响评估转化为患者可访问、可争议的机制，赋予患者知情、访问和提出质疑的权利，为欧盟数字健康治理提供了可落地的政策改革方向。

title: Green Capital Regulation, Regulatory Leakage, and Systemic Risk
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice

detail.title: Green Capital Regulation, Regulatory Leakage, and Systemic Risk
detail.abstract: We study the systemic and macroeconomic implications of green bank regulation in a general equilibrium model with regulated and unregulated financial intermediaries. When commercial banks face capital surcharges on carbon-intensive (``brown'') assets, credit demand endogenously migrates to the unregulated shadow banking sector. While traditional banks successfully de-risk, this regulatory leakage concentrates transition risk within highly leveraged non-bank intermediaries relying on runnable wholesale funding. Under a negative climate transition shock, shadow banks face funding runs and liquidate specialized assets. This fire sale generates pecuniary externalities that devalue collateral throughout the economy, translating a localized environmental shock into a systemic macroeconomic contraction. We characterize the optimal macroprudential policy mix and show that combining moderate capital constraints with green technology incentives minimizes the marginal cost of transition while preserving financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文在一般均衡模型中研究绿色银行监管的系统性影响。当商业银行对棕色资产面临资本附加费时，信贷需求会迁移至不受监管的影子银行部门，导致监管泄漏。影子银行在负面气候转型冲击下面临资金挤兑和资产抛售，产生价格外部性，将局部环境冲击转化为系统性宏观经济收缩。最优政策组合是适度资本约束与绿色技术激励相结合。
AI.research_question: 绿色银行监管（对棕色资产征收资本附加费）在一般均衡中会产生怎样的系统性影响？如何设计最优的宏观审慎政策组合以实现气候转型与金融稳定的平衡？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多关注绿色银行监管在传统银行体系内的直接影响，忽略了信贷活动可能向不受监管的影子银行部门迁移的"监管套利"渠道，从而低估了绿色监管可能带来的系统性金融风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型，包含受监管的商业银行与不受监管的影子银行两类金融中介；基于资本监管、流动性风险（资金挤兑）和价格外部性（火线抛售）的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建包含两类金融中介（受监管银行与影子银行）的一般均衡模型；引入气候转型冲击，分析绿色资本监管下的信贷迁移、影子银行挤兑与资产抛售机制；并求解最优宏观审慎政策组合。
AI.findings: （1）绿色资本附加费导致信贷向影子银行迁移，传统银行成功去风险但影子银行集中了更高的转型风险；（2）负面气候转型冲击下影子银行遭遇资金挤兑并抛售资产，火线抛售产生价格外部性，导致整个经济体的抵押品贬值，将局部环境冲击放大为系统性宏观经济收缩；（3）最优政策组合为适度资本约束加绿色技术激励，以最小化转型的边际成本并维护金融稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了绿色银行监管的"监管泄漏"机制及其系统性风险传导渠道；为绿色监管的金融稳定后果提供了新的理论框架；拓展了宏观审慎政策与气候政策交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计绿色金融监管政策提供理论指导，表明单纯依赖银行资本监管可能适得其反，需要配合绿色技术激励措施以实现最优的政策组合。

title: Geopolitical Supply Disruptions Macro Economic Shocks: Effects of Strait of Hormuz Blockade and the Price of $112.57 of Crude Oil in the Indian Economy An Econometric and Policy Viewpoint in its Totality

detail.title: Geopolitical Supply Disruptions Macro Economic Shocks: Effects of Strait of Hormuz Blockade and the Price of $112.57 of Crude Oil in the Indian Economy An Econometric and Policy Viewpoint in its Totality
detail.abstract: Geopolitical risks of dependency on essential energy transit chokepoints are threatening for import dependent emerging economies. This is an attempt to ascertain the structural and macro-economic consequences that a hypothetical (but credible) energy shock, a complete blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, will have on the Indian economy. The event where the Strait of Hormuz is blocked would result in an increase in Brent crude oil prices from $72/barrel to $112.57/barrel, indicating a spike of 55.3%. This is significant, as approximately 20% of world's flow of crude oil and LNG passes through this critical transit choke-point. Given that, India is highly dependent (over 85%) for almost every unit of crude oil it consumes, and about half of the natural gas it needs, a crisis scenario will create interruptions across a majority of Indian economy sectors. This research has constructed a framework analysis to trace down immediate and secondary consequences on 5 major Indian macroeconomic variables (balance of payments, domestic price stability, fiscal space, monetary policy and the status of money and capital markets). The policy response required should encompass measures like raising the SPR, establishing non-dollar trade facilities, expediting the green hydrogen production and its adoption in the Indian context and diversifying the transit routes.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了假设波斯湾霍尔木兹海峡被完全封锁这一能源冲击情景对印度经济的影响，发现布伦特原油价格将上涨55.3%至每桶112.57美元，并通过框架分析追踪了该冲击对印度五大宏观经济变量的直接与间接后果，最后提出了相应的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 假设霍尔木兹海峡被完全封锁（一个可信的能源冲击情景），将对印度经济产生怎样的结构性和宏观经济后果？
AI.motivation: 印度作为进口依赖型新兴经济体，超过85%的原油消费依赖进口，且约一半天然气需求依赖进口，高度依赖霍尔木兹海峡这一关键能源过境咽喉要道。地缘政治风险对这种关键能源过境咽喉要道的依赖构成了严重威胁，因此有必要评估这种冲击对印度经济的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源安全与地缘政治风险理论，通过能源过境咽喉要道依赖度分析框架，追踪能源冲击的传导机制。
AI.method: 构建框架分析法，追踪能源冲击对印度五大宏观经济变量（国际收支、国内价格稳定、财政空间、货币政策以及货币与资本市场状况）的直接和间接后果。
AI.findings: 霍尔木兹海峡被封锁将导致布伦特原油价格从每桶72美元飙升至112.57美元，涨幅达55.3%。由于约20%的世界原油和液化天然气流量通过该海峡，且印度高度依赖进口能源，这一危机情景将在印度大多数经济部门造成中断，影响五大宏观经济变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 为能源地缘政治风险对进口依赖型新兴经济体的宏观经济传导机制提供了系统分析框架，特别是针对特定能源过境咽喉要道封锁情景下量化了宏观经济影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的政策应对建议，包括提高战略石油储备（SPR）、建立非美元贸易设施、加快绿色氢能生产及其在印度的应用推广、以及多元化能源过境路线等。

title: Genetics and Environmental Law A Legal Study on Biosafety, Genetic Resources, Biodiversity and New Genomic Techniques
affiliations: NATIONAL KAPODISTRIAN UNIVERSITY OF ATHENS

detail.title: Genetics and Environmental Law A Legal Study on Biosafety, Genetic Resources, Biodiversity and New Genomic Techniques
detail.abstract: Genetic science has changed the architecture of environmental law. Environmental regulation no longer concerns only emissions, waste, protected areas and administrative permits. It also concerns genetic resources, hereditary diversity, biotechnology, living modified organisms, digital sequence information and the legal consequences of altering organisms before they enter ecosystems, markets or food chains. This study examines the interaction between genetics and environmental law through international biodiversity law, biosafety law, European Union GMO and NGT regulation, access and benefit-sharing, conservation genetics and liability. Its central thesis is that genetics does not displace the classical tools of environmental law. It adds a more demanding regulatory layer, because legal systems must govern ecological risk before it becomes visible, regulate information detached from biological material, and distribute benefits arising from biodiversity without undermining scientific research or conservation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨遗传科学如何重塑环境法的架构，指出遗传学并未取代经典环境法工具，而是增加了更严格的监管层面，涉及生物多样性法、生物安全法、欧盟GMO与NGT监管、获取与惠益分享、保护遗传学及责任等多个维度。
AI.research_question: 遗传科学与环境法之间的相互作用是什么？遗传学如何改变环境法的监管架构？
AI.motivation: 遗传科学的发展已从根本上改变了环境法的范畴——从传统治理排放、废弃物、保护区和行政许可，扩展到遗传资源、生物多样性、生物技术、活体改良生物、数字序列信息等新领域，因此需要系统审视这一变化及其法律影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境法的核心论点：遗传学并未取代环境法的经典工具，而是在其上叠加了更严格的监管层次，要求法律体系在生态风险显性化之前就进行治理、对脱离生物材料的遗传信息进行监管，以及在保护科学与研究之间分配生物多样性利益。
AI.method: 文献综述与法律分析，通过国际生物多样性法、生物安全法、欧盟GMO与NGT法规、获取与惠益分享制度、保护遗传学和责任制度等维度进行交叉分析。
AI.findings: 遗传学为环境法增加了三个核心治理挑战：(1) 在生态风险显现之前进行预防性规制；(2) 监管与生物材料分离的遗传信息（如数字序列信息）；(3) 在保护生物多样性与不阻碍科学研究之间分配惠益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"遗传学作为环境法附加监管层"的理论框架，阐明遗传学与环境法之间不是替代关系而是叠加关系，为理解现代环境法的演进提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法律从业者提供了遗传学背景下环境法监管重点的系统梳理，有助于完善遗传资源获取、惠益分享、生物安全等具体法律制度设计。

title: Testing for Alpha Instability in High-Dimensional Asset Pricing Models
affiliations: Nankai University, Southeast University, Nankai University and Nankai University

detail.title: Testing for Alpha Instability in High-Dimensional Asset Pricing Models
detail.abstract: We propose tests for a change point in the alpha vector of a high-dimensional linear asset pricing model. The number of assets may exceed the sample size, observed factors may be serially dependent, and idiosyncratic errors are serially independent with general crosssectional dependence. After estimating factor loadings by full-sample least squares, we apply cumulative sum transformations to the residual panel after removing only the fitted factor component. Unweighted and self-normalized scans yield two bias-corrected sum statistics for dense alpha breaks and two maximum statistics for sparse breaks. Full-sample loading estimation and difference-based studentization create nonnegligible centering effects in high dimensions; we correct them explicitly and estimate the dense variance index with a U-statistic. We derive the null limits of the four component statistics and prove asymptotic independence between the corresponding sum and maximum statistics. The resulting Cauchy-combination tests adapt to unknown sparsity. Residual-bootstrap simulations show accurate size control and stable power across sparsity regimes. An application to 375 S&P 500 stocks finds evidence of a broad-based alpha shift around June 2008.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高维线性资产定价模型中的alpha向量变点检测问题，提出了四种检验统计量（两个密集变点的总和统计量和两个稀疏变点的最大值统计量），通过偏差校正处理高维中心化效应，并利用柯西组合检验自适应未知稀疏度，模拟和实证均验证了方法的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何在高维线性资产定价模型中检测alpha向量的变点，特别是在资产数量可能超过样本量、因子存在序列相关、误差项具有一般截面相关性的条件下？
AI.motivation: 已有的alpha变点检验方法多针对低维或横截面独立误差情形，难以应对高维资产定价面板（资产数可能超过样本量）以及一般截面相关结构。需要开发新的统计检验方法以同时处理密集和稀疏alpha断点场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高维线性资产定价模型；累积和（CUSUM）变换；自归一化扫描统计量；U统计量估计；柯西组合检验；偏差校正理论
AI.method: 首先通过全样本最小二乘估计因子载荷，仅去除拟合的因子成分后对残差面板应用累积和变换。构建两个偏差校正的总和统计量（用于密集alpha断点）和两个最大值统计量（用于稀疏断点），通过差分方法进行学生化处理并使用U统计量估计密集方差指数。推导四种分量统计量的零分布极限，证明总和与最大值统计量之间的渐近独立性，最终用柯西组合检验实现自适应未知稀疏度。
AI.findings: 推导了四种分量统计量的零分布极限并证明了相应的总和与最大值统计量的渐近独立性；残余自助模拟显示方法在不同稀疏度下均能准确控制尺寸并保持稳定功效；应用于375只标普500股票的实证研究发现2008年6月前后存在广泛性的alpha偏移。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在高维（资产数可超过样本量）资产定价模型中解决了alpha变点检测问题；明确刻画并校正了全样本载荷估计和差分学生化产生的非可忽略中心化效应；证明了总和统计量与最大值统计量之间的渐近独立性，为柯西组合检验提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了能自适应未知稀疏度的alpha变点检验方法，可应用于大规模股票组合的定价模型稳定性监测，为投资策略调整和风险管理提供统计依据；实证发现了2008年金融危机期间标普500股票广泛性的alpha结构变化。

title: Task Dependence and the Return to Research
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: Task Dependence and the Return to Research
detail.abstract: When a production function is the upper envelope over available techniques (1), the elasticityof output to the stock of ideas is the reciprocal of an extreme-value index, and that indexdepends on whether a technique good at one task tends to be good at the others. With asymmetric constant-elasticity strict-complement technology, independent Pareto draws giveindex nα and a common factor gives α: the return to research differs by the number oftasks between economies with identical marginal tail indices—28 basis points of annualgrowth per head at the restrictive baseline, 112 with no duplication and moderatestanding-on-shoulders (χ = 1, ψ = 0.5). The same choice fixes the aggregate’s shape.For the Leontief benchmark, independence makes the envelope’s scale a tail scale anddelivers an exactly Cobb–Douglas envelope; a common factor replaces it with a moment,explicitly non-monomial in the two-task case. More generally curvature is governed by anexact cross-derivative identity and survives under stated ray conditions, so curvature persistsbut not the curvature assumed. Cobb–Douglas is the unique robust local form. The effectivetail ratio k/α is identified from two tail indices. Keywords: production functions; returns toresearch; regular variation; aggregation

AI.tldr: 本文研究当生产函数是可用技术的上包络线时，产出对创意存量的弹性等于极值指数的倒数。该指数取决于一项技术在某一任务上表现良好是否也倾向于在其他任务上表现良好。在对称常替代弹性严格互补技术下，独立的Pareto分布给出指数nα，共同因子给出α：具有相同边际尾指数的经济体之间，研究回报因任务数量而异——在限制性基线下为年人均增长的28个基点，在无重复和适度站巨人肩上（χ=1, ψ=0.5）时为112个基点。同样的选择决定了总体的形状。对于Leontief基准，独立性使包络线的尺度成为尾部尺度，并产生精确的Cobb-Douglas包络线；共同因子则用矩（在两个任务情形下明确非单项式）替代它。更一般地，曲率由精确的交叉导数恒等式控制，并在规定的射线条件下得以维持，因此曲率持续存在但并非假设的曲率。Cobb-Douglas是唯一稳健的局部形式。有效尾部比率k/α由两个尾部指数识别。
AI.research_question: 当生产函数是可用技术的上包络线时，产出对创意存量的弹性如何取决于技术分布的性质（特别是技术的多任务相关性）？
AI.motivation: 传统增长模型假设生产函数具有特定的函数形式（如Cobb-Douglas），但实际生产函数是从可用技术中通过上包络线推导出来的。理解这种包络线的形状以及其对研究回报的影响，对于解释经济增长差异至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极值理论（extreme value theory）、正则变化（regular variation）、常替代弹性（CES）生产函数、Leontief生产函数、Cobb-Douglas生产函数
AI.method: 理论建模与数学推导：通过上包络线构造生产函数，分析独立Pareto分布与共同因子情形下的极值指数，并进行精确的交叉导数恒等式推导。
AI.findings: （1）独立Pareto分布下弹性指数为nα，共同因子下为α，研究回报差异从28个基点到112个基点；（2）Leontief基准下独立性产生精确的Cobb-Douglas包络线，共同因子则产生非单项式形式；（3）曲率由精确交叉导数恒等式控制且持续存在，但并非假设的曲率；（4）Cobb-Douglas是唯一稳健的局部形式；（5）有效尾部比率k/α可由两个尾部指数识别。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）建立了生产函数作为技术包络线的尺度理论，连接极值理论与经济增长；（2）证明了Cobb-Douglas是唯一稳健的局部生产函数形式；（3）提供了研究回报差异的理论解释，将任务数量与技术相关性纳入分析框架；（4）揭示了曲率持续存在但形式不同于假设的重要发现。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为比较不同经济体的研究回报提供了量化框架（28到112个基点）；（2）为政策制定者理解研发投入回报差异提供了理论基础；（3）通过尾部指数识别有效尾部比率，为实证研究提供了可检验的理论预测。

title: From Flint to Ai: A Journey Through Technology's Transformative History
affiliations: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Ghana - Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST), College of Humanities and Social Sciences and

detail.title: From Flint to Ai: A Journey Through Technology's Transformative History
detail.abstract: Purpose This study seeks to comprehensively analyse the transformative history of technology. It begins from the Stone Age to the 21st century, where it investigates major technological milestones that have revolutionized human capabilities and reshaped societal frameworks. Methods The authors utilised a systematic literature review across multiple academic literatures such as books, journals, websites and electronic databases. Data collection and thematic analysis were guided by the subthemes “Origins of Technology, “Evolution of Technology,” and “Artificial Intelligence.” Results The research brought to light the technological progression across distinct historical eras. It highlights the tools in the Stone Age era, the invention of the wheel, the Industrial Revolution, and the digital revolution. Furthermore, the revolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a force that has transformed the globe today. This ranges from healthcare to the economy, to education, commerce, and transportation, among others. Conclusion Technology is and continues to remain an important aspect of human civilization. As the world advances through the information age, the ultimate impact of emerging cognitive technologies will depend heavily on global commitment to ethical governance, inclusivity, and responsible implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述，全面梳理了从石器时代到21世纪的技术变革史，涵盖石器工具、车轮发明、工业革命、数字革命及人工智能革命等关键里程碑，并探讨了技术对人类能力和社会框架的深刻影响。
AI.research_question: 技术从石器时代到21世纪经历了怎样的转型历史？各历史时期有哪些重大技术里程碑，它们如何重塑了人类能力与社会框架？
AI.motivation: 技术是文明进步的核心驱动力，但缺乏对其转型历史的全面系统性梳理。作者旨在通过跨时代的综合审视，揭示技术演化的整体脉络及其对社会发展的深远影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究采用文献综述方法，以“技术的起源”“技术的演变”和“人工智能”三个子主题为分析框架，属于历史叙事与技术演化的整合视角。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述法。作者从书籍、期刊、网站和电子数据库等多个学术来源收集数据，并围绕三个预设子主题进行数据收集与主题分析。
AI.findings: 研究揭示了不同历史时期的技术演进轨迹：石器时代工具、车轮的发明、工业革命和数字革命均为关键里程碑。人工智能作为当代变革性力量，已在医疗、经济、教育、商业和交通等多个领域产生全球性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究构建了一个跨时代的宏观技术演进框架，将人工智能置于人类技术发展的历史长河中进行定位，为技术史研究提供了整合性视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究强调了在信息时代，新兴认知技术的最终影响取决于全球在伦理治理、包容性和负责任实施方面的承诺，为政策制定者和技术实践者提供了方向性指引。

reference: HSE Basic Research Programme Working Paper Series
title: The Social Life of Innovation: Trust, Resistance, and the Unequal Costs of Change
affiliations: National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow), affiliation not provided to SSRN, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tsinghua University - School of Public Policy and Management, Tsinghua University, Universidade Estadual de Campinas (UNICAMP) - School of Applied Sciences, Universidade Estadual de Campinas (UNICAMP) - School of Applied Sciences, Universidade Estadual de Campinas (UNICAMP) - School of Applied Sciences and

detail.title: The Social Life of Innovation: Trust, Resistance, and the Unequal Costs of Change

publicationDetails.detailsText: HSE Basic Research Programme Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Innovation has been discussed in political, academic, management and public debates for many years. It’s usually understood as a driver of change and economic development in different contexts depending on the nature of the debate. What is often neglected is society and people’s perceptions. In each debate, a handful of representatives of social groups claim the authority to define how innovation should be interpreted, used, and understood. Consequently, numerous theories have emerged highlighting innovation's meaning for different purposes, always depending on the scope and perception.

The collective working paper now collects a broad range of aspects on the topic. It’s split into two parts: the first looks at how societies judge innovation, and the second discusses winners and losers.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论创新在政治、学术、管理和公共辩论中被广泛讨论，但往往忽视了社会和人们的感知。论文指出各社会群体的代表声称有权定义创新的解释、使用和理解方式，导致众多理论因范围和感知不同而凸显创新对不同目的的意义。该集体工作论文收集了关于该主题的广泛方面，分为两部分：第一部分探讨社会如何评判创新，第二部分讨论赢家和输家。
AI.research_question: 创新在不同社会语境中如何被定义和评判？谁有权定义创新？创新带来的收益和代价如何在社会中分配？
AI.motivation: 传统的创新讨论多聚焦于其作为变革和经济发展驱动力的角色，但往往忽视了社会和公众的感知。各社会群体的代表声称拥有定义创新解释、使用和理解方式的权威，这种权力分配和认知差异值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文属于集体工作论文（collective working paper），没有明确单一的理论框架，而是汇集了关于创新的多学科视角，涵盖社会学、管理学、政治学和公共政策等多领域的理论观点。
AI.method: 该文为集体工作论文（collective working paper），采用文献综述和多方观点汇编的方式，收集了关于创新的广泛方面。论文分为两部分：第一部分探讨社会如何评判创新，第二部分讨论创新中的赢家和输家。
AI.findings: 论文指出创新在不同辩论语境中总是取决于辩论性质和范围，并由少数社会群体代表决定创新应如何被解释、使用和理解。创新不仅仅带来经济收益，也涉及赢家和输家的分化。
AI.theory_contributions: 该文强调了社会感知和公众视角在创新研究中的重要性，弥补了传统创新文献中忽视社会层面和公众认知的不足，提出了创新定义权归属这一核心问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、管理者和公众提供了一种更全面的创新理解框架，提示在创新讨论和决策中应当纳入更多社会群体的声音，关注创新的分配效应（赢家与输家）。

title: Presidential Alpha: Relative Performance Evaluation of US Economic Leadership
affiliations: Simon Fraser University (SFU) - Beedie School of Business

detail.title: Presidential Alpha: Relative Performance Evaluation of US Economic Leadership
detail.abstract: How much of a president's economic record is his own doing, rather than the conditions he inherited and the global forces of his era? For each of the 34 US presidential terms since 1885 we build a counterfactual United States from comparable economies whose equity premiums tracked the US beforehand, and define presidential alpha as US performance net of that benchmark. Alpha varies widely, ranging from about-1.2% to +1.4% per month, yet individual terms are rarely distinguishable from chance. Removing the shared environment, the partisan gap in prior work disappears, though Republican terms are more dispersed, and the US outperforms comparable economies on average. Neither historians nor voters reward the president's own contribution: historians reward the economy a president inherited, voters realized growth. Yet what they overlook is real: alpha predicts subsequent GDP per capita growth, so presidents are scored on the economy's luck, not the value they add.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建反事实基准（利用与美国总统任期前股票风险溢价走势相似的可比经济体），将1885年以来34个美国总统任期的经济表现分解为"总统个人贡献"（alpha）与"外部环境（继承条件+全球力量）"两部分。研究发现总统alpha差异显著（约-1.2%至+1.4%/月），但单任期难以与随机区分；控制环境后，此前文献中的党派差距消失（共和党任期内波动更大），美国平均跑赢可比经济体。历史学家和选民均未奖励总统的自身贡献（史学家奖励继承的经济环境，选民奖励实际增长），但alpha确实能预测后续人均GDP增长，说明总统被按经济运气而非增值能力打分。
AI.research_question: 美国总统任期内经济表现中有多大比例是总统本人的贡献，而非继承的条件和所处时代的全球力量所致？
AI.motivation: 现有研究在评估总统经济责任时往往混淆环境因素与个人贡献，导致党派差距等结论可能失真；作者希望剥离共同环境，精确度量总统的经济"增值"（alpha）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反事实/基准对照框架（利用事前股票风险溢价相似的可比经济体构建反事实美国）；绩效归因（分解环境与个体贡献）；"总统alpha"概念。
AI.method: 对1885年以来34个美国总统任期，选取事前股票风险溢价与美国匹配的可比经济体构建反事实美国，以美国表现减去该基准得到总统alpha；比较党派差异，并检验alpha对后续人均GDP增长的预测能力。
AI.findings: （1）总统alpha范围约为-1.2%至+1.4%/月，幅度大但单个任期通常与随机无法区分；（2）剥离共同环境后，先前文献的党派差距消失，但共和党任期表现更离散；（3）美国整体跑赢可比经济体；（4）历史学家奖励总统继承的经济，选民奖励实际增长，均不奖励总统自身贡献；（5）alpha能预测后续人均GDP增长，说明总统被依据运气而非增值进行评价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了"总统alpha"这一新概念及反事实基准方法，挑战了既有关于党派经济绩效差异的结论，揭示评价机制（史学与选民）对总统经济贡献的认知偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公众、历史学家及政策评估者提供更科学的总统经济绩效度量方法，帮助区分运气（环境）与能力（增值），改进对总统历史评价及选举投票的理性程度。

title: Proof as Constitutional Infrastructure for Workflow Sequencing Limited-Visibility Access Control and AI-Bounded Governance in NewVistas
affiliations: Quaid-i-Azam University and NewVistas Foundation

detail.title: Proof as Constitutional Infrastructure for Workflow Sequencing Limited-Visibility Access Control and AI-Bounded Governance in NewVistas
detail.abstract: Agency 11 is conceptualized neither as a policy-making agency nor as a centralized data authority, surveillance system, court, accountant, underwriter, publication office, or operating business. Its function implements approved rules by making constitutional actions identifiable, authorized, sequenced, versioned, access-controlled, logged, reproducible, tamper-evident, and auditable. The paper proposes a finite-state proof-workflow algebra with limited-visibility access control to formalize this role. The framework models each constitutionally significant action as a valid state transition 𝑋 𝑡+1 = 𝑓 𝛼 (𝑋 𝑡), where validity depends on credential, permission, sequence, version, visibility, settlement, temporal, immutability, and AI-boundary gates. Every valid action generates a structured proof object containing actor identity, role, domain, action, timestamp, approved rule version, visibility profile, and digital signature. Workflow sequencing is represented as a directed acyclic graph, while access permissions are represented through credential-permission and fieldlevel visibility matrices. The framework also formalizes the settlement sequence, fixed temporal constitution, version-control lattice, cybersecurity immutability gate, and AIassist-not-decide boundary. The core contribution is to show how NewVistas converts constitutional governance into algebraically valid proof transitions without converting proof into surveillance. Agency 11 proves without deciding, implements without creating policy, enforces sequence without judging substance, and preserves digital completeness without centralized visibility. The framework contributes to institutional economics, digital constitutionalism, workflow governance, distributed systems, identity architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, and AI-risk governance by demonstrating how constitutional order can be made operational at transaction scale while preserving privacy, agency separation, human accountability, and trigger-bound audit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"机构11"（Agency 11）的概念，它不是政策制定机构或集中式数据权威，而是一个通过有限状态证明工作流代数（finite-state proof-workflow algebra）与有限可见性访问控制来执行已批准规则的机构。该框架将每个宪法意义上的行动建模为有效状态转换，生成结构化证明对象，并通过有向无环图管理工作流排序、通过可见性矩阵管理访问权限。核心贡献在于展示NewVistas如何将宪法治理转化为代数上有效的证明转换，同时不将证明转化为监视。
AI.research_question: 如何将宪法治理转化为可操作、可审计的代数有效证明转换，同时不将证明转化为监视，保持隐私、机构分离与人类问责？
AI.motivation: 现有的治理框架要么依赖集中式数据权威（可能侵犯隐私），要么缺乏将宪法规则转化为可验证、可审计的运作机制。需要一个既保证宪法规则被严格执行、又避免权力集中和监视风险的正式框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限状态证明工作流代数、有限可见性访问控制、制度经济学、数字宪政主义、工作流治理、分布式系统、身份架构、网络安全、隐私与AI风险治理。
AI.method: 本文采用形式化建模方法，提出一个有限状态证明工作流代数，将宪法行动建模为状态转换（X_{t+1}=fα(X_t)），通过九道门（凭证、权限、序列、版本、可见性、结算、时间、不可变性、AI边界）验证有效性，并以有向无环图表示工作流排序，以凭证-权限和字段级可见性矩阵表示访问权限。
AI.findings: 该框架证明NewVistas能够将宪法治理转化为代数有效的证明转换：（1）机构11证明而不决定；（2）实施而不制定政策；（3）强制序列而不判断实质；（4）保持数字完整性而不集中可见性。每个有效行动生成包含行动者身份、角色、领域、行动、时间戳、批准规则版本、可见性配置和数字签名的结构化证明对象。
AI.theory_contributions: 为制度经济学、数字宪政主义、工作流治理、分布式系统、身份架构、网络安全、隐私和AI风险治理领域提供了将宪法秩序在交易规模上操作用的形式化框架，同时保持隐私、机构分离、人类问责和触发式审计。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可在实际治理体系中实施的操作方案：通过代数验证与证明对象生成，使宪法规则的执行可审计、可验证、可复现，同时避免集中监视和权力滥用，支持AI辅助而不越界的边界设定。

title: Mother's Education and Child Nutrition: Evidence of Intergenerational Effect from a School Cycle Program, India
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur and Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur

detail.title: Mother's Education and Child Nutrition: Evidence of Intergenerational Effect from a School Cycle Program, India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: The research recieved no funding by any profit/non-profit organization.

detail.abstract: We study the intergenerational effect, channeled through mothers' education, of a school-cycle program targeting girls enrolled in Class Nine on child nutrition outcomes in the Indian state of Bihar. Utilizing nationally representative individual-level data, our difference-indifference estimates show that the nutritional status of children whose mothers were exposed to the program has improved significantly. Children of treated mothers are 1.7 and 0.9 percentage points less likely to be stunted and underweight, respectively. Under tighter model specifications, the reduction in stunting remains statistically significant, while the reduction in underweight is smaller. The observed positive effects are plausibly driven by increased maternal education, higher income, declining fertility, longer birth intervals, greater media exposure, and improved access to maternal and child health services. The heterogeneity analysis indicates that the effects are larger among children from upper castes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度比哈尔邦一项针对九年级女童的学校周期项目，通过母亲教育渠道对儿童营养结果的代际影响。利用双重差分估计发现，暴露于该项目的母亲所生育的子女营养状况显著改善，发育迟缓和体重不足的概率分别降低1.7和0.9个百分点。
AI.research_question: 针对九年级女童的学校周期项目，通过母亲教育的代际渠道，如何影响儿童营养结果？
AI.motivation: 理解教育干预项目如何通过代际传递改善儿童营养状况，为发展中国家教育政策和儿童健康政策提供经验证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、代际传递理论（母亲教育对子女健康的影响机制）
AI.method: 利用全国代表性个体层面数据，采用双重差分（difference-in-differences）估计方法，并进行更严格的模型设定检验和异质性分析。
AI.findings: 母亲暴露于项目的儿童发育迟缓和体重不足概率分别降低1.7和0.9个百分点；在更严格模型下发育迟缓的降低仍显著，体重不足的降低幅度变小；效应由母亲教育提升、收入增加、生育率下降、生育间隔延长、媒体接触增加和妇幼保健服务可及性改善驱动；上等种姓家庭的儿童效应更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了教育干预通过代际渠道影响儿童健康的因果证据，丰富了人力资本代际传递的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家设计针对女童的教育干预项目提供了政策依据，表明教育投资可产生跨代健康收益。

title: Pathways to Global Methane Mitigation: Cost-Effective Regional and Sectoral Supply-Side Solutions
affiliations: Research Triangle Institute, RTI International, RTI International, RTI International and RTI International

detail.title: Pathways to Global Methane Mitigation: Cost-Effective Regional and Sectoral Supply-Side Solutions
detail.abstract: In 2021, the US and EU launched the Global Methane Pledge aiming to reduce emissions by 30% below 2020 levels by 2030 (about 2,985 MtCO2e). Since its launch, 159 countries and the European Commission have joined the initiative.  With less than five years remaining to achieve this target—and despite evolving political landscapes and shifting national priorities—identifying cost-effective mitigation strategies remains critically important. Given the considerable variation in methane abatement potential and costs across countries and sectors, a disaggregated global assessment is essential. This study focuses on direct methane abatement activities as a key component of the mitigation portfolio. Results indicate that 73% of the Pledge (about 2,400 MtCO2e) can be achieved through technological interventions costing less than 100$/tCO2e by 2030, with the energy sector offering the largest potential. Reaching the Pledge target by 2030 is unlikely at this point, but these findings underscore the feasibility of targeted technological action and highlight the regional differences in abatement potential that shape progress toward global methane mitigation goals.

AI.tldr: 本研究对全球甲烷减排承诺（Global Methane Pledge）进行了细粒度的国家与部门层面的减排潜力与成本评估，发现通过成本低于100美元/tCO2e的技术干预措施可在2030年前实现该承诺73%的减排目标（约2400 MtCO2e），其中能源部门潜力最大；但按当前进度2030年完全达标的可能性较低。
AI.research_question: 在距2030年目标不足五年的背景下，全球甲烷减排承诺中有多少比例可以通过何种技术干预措施、以何种成本实现？不同国家和部门的减排潜力与成本差异如何？
AI.motivation: 全球甲烷承诺设定2030年前较2020年减排30%的目标，但当前政治格局演变与各国优先事项变化使得目标实现面临挑战，且各国各部门的甲烷减排潜力和成本差异显著，亟需进行细粒度的全球评估以识别最具成本效益的减排策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 甲烷减排成本-潜力分析框架，基于跨国家跨部门的减排边际成本曲线（MACC）评估方法。
AI.method: 对159个国家及欧盟委员会进行分解式（disaggregated）的全球评估，聚焦直接甲烷减排活动，评估不同技术干预措施在各国家与各部门的减排潜力及单位成本。
AI.findings: （1）承诺的73%（约2400 MtCO2e）可通过成本低于100美元/tCO2e的技术干预措施在2030年前实现；（2）能源部门提供最大减排潜力；（3）到2030年完全实现承诺目标的可能性较低；（4）各国减排潜力存在显著区域差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了全球甲烷减排承诺的细粒度、跨国家跨部门的量化评估，填补了以往粗粒度评估的空白，为理解全球甲烷减排可行性与区域差异提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别最具成本效益的甲烷减排优先领域（尤其是能源部门）提供实证依据，有助于优化全球甲烷减排资源配置与行动策略。

title: Over-Specified Contract and Reporting Networks Structural Deficiency, Evidence Obstructions, and Standardized Agreement

detail.title: Over-Specified Contract and Reporting Networks Structural Deficiency, Evidence Obstructions, and Standardized Agreement
detail.abstract: Contract and reporting networks pose distinct questions: do bilateral interface terms admit a common contract state, and do independently retained contracts, operational records, accounting entries, audit evidence, and disclosures admit a common transaction state? One obstruction calculus addresses both while separating their state spaces and meanings. For the bilateral layer, the incidence-Jacobian sheaf identifies compatible tangent directions through H 0 con,s and derivative disagreement through H 1 con,s , the cokernel of the reduced agreement derivative. Vanishing of H 1 con,s certifies Jacobian surjectivity-a constraint qualification-at a specified state, not nonlinear consistency or image membership of a realized forcing. A Hall-Rado formula computes generic obstruction dimension; coordinated standardized terms may insert a consensus locus despite structural deficiency. We augment the framework with latent facts, anchored retained-record variables, and factor-supported semantic maps. A packet is jointly representable exactly when it lies in the semantic map's image. Anchoring preserves provenance and yields a coordinate-invariant reporting obstruction. Factor-support formulas govern freely varying derivative blocks; fixed semantics require actual rank. Reciprocal telecom capacity swaps apply this separation. A minimal benchmark with two indefeasible rights of use (IRUs) is regular, with H 1 con = 0. Yet the June 2001 Qwest-FLAG signed confirmation and internal investigation answer the same commitment-status question oppositely, producing a documented exact affine reporting incompatibility. A federal judicial record identifies a Qwest-Cable & Wireless upgrade agreement barring up-front recognition alongside inconsistent up-front treatment. They illustrate reporting obstruction, not fraud or positive bilateral H 1 .

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的阻碍计算框架，同时处理双边合同层和报告网络层的状态一致性问题。通过定义incidence-Jacobian层，用H⁰和H¹分别刻画合同层的状态兼容性和导数分歧；在报告层引入潜在事实、锚定保留记录变量和因子支持的语义映射，以判定数据包的可联合表示性，并用电信容量互换（如Qwest-FLAG案）作为实证案例说明报告阻碍与欺诈或双边H¹为正的区别。
AI.research_question: 双边接口条款能否承认一个共同的合同状态，以及独立保留的合同、运营记录、会计条目、审计证据和披露能否承认一个共同的交易状态？
AI.motivation: 合同与报告网络各自存在一致性问题，但缺乏一个统一框架来同时处理二者并区分其状态空间与含义，特别是需要区分结构性的阻碍与欺诈行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: incidence-Jacobian层理论、H⁰/H¹上同调、Hall-Rado公式、约束资格条件（constraint qualification）、语义映射、因子支持公式。
AI.method: 通过层论与上同调方法构建阻碍演算框架；利用incidence-Jacobian层分析双边层的兼容切向与导数分歧；引入潜在事实和锚定保留记录变量构造坐标不变的报告阻碍；用电信容量互换案例（两个IRU基准、Qwest-FLAG案、Qwest-Cable & Wire案）进行实证应用。
AI.findings: H¹的消失可证明Jacobian满射性（约束资格），但不保证非线性一致性；因子支持公式控制自由变化的导数块，固定语义需要实际秩；基准双IRU案例具有正则性（H¹=0），但Qwest-FLAG确认函与内部调查对同一承诺状态问题给出相反答案，产生精确仿射报告不兼容；司法记录显示Qwest-Cable & Wireless升级协议禁止提前确认却存在不一致的提前处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了合同层与报告层的阻碍计算框架，同时明确区分二者的状态空间和含义；将层论上同调工具引入会计与审计信息一致性分析；区分了约束资格条件与非线性一致性/图像成员资格的层次。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计和监管提供识别报告阻碍的数学工具，区分结构性不一致与欺诈行为；通过电信行业案例展示框架在真实商业场景中的应用价值。

title:
Reconsidering Coase in the Age of AI: 
Why the Boundary of the Firm Is Eroding, with Legal Services as the Worked Example
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Reconsidering Coase in the Age of AI: 
Why the Boundary of the Firm Is Eroding, with Legal Services as the Worked Example

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author note and declared interest: Mark Kingsley-Williams is an IP lawyer, former economics consultant, and founder of AiLA, an external AI legal department. AiLA is an early implementation of the external-harness model discussed in this paper.

detail.abstract: Coase explained the firm as the answer to transaction costs. Work stays inside when specifying, verifying and directing outsiders costs more than hiring employees. This note argues that AI erodes the assumptions behind that answer, rather than merely lowering the costs. Engineered systems known as harnesses largely complete contracts in real time, make external work more observable than employment, and carry context and control across the firm's edge. As a result, the boundary that predicts where context sits, who controls the work, and where knowledge accumulates becomes the instrumented system, not the legal entity. Legal services, the profession organised most completely around Coasean frictions, is the worked example. Three tests decide the order in which work migrates. Three un-Coasean consequences follow. The boundary becomes something providers compete to move, knowledge pools with them, and incentives invert toward legal dispute prevention. Four conditions identify which other sectors restructure. The argument is predictive because the external-harness model is still early, and the pace is set by organisational inertia rather than the technology itself.

AI.tldr: 本文认为人工智能并非仅仅降低交易成本，而是侵蚀了科斯企业理论的核心假设。通过"驾驭系统"（harnesses）在实时完成合同、使外部工作比雇佣更可观察、并在企业边界传递情境与控制，组织的边界从法律实体转变为工具化系统。以法律服务为典型案例，提出了工作迁移的三个测试、三个非科斯式后果，以及识别其他行业重构的四个条件。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何从根本上改变企业边界决定因素？具体而言，AI如何在超越单纯成本降低的层面上侵蚀科斯企业理论的前提假设，从而重构组织的边界逻辑？
AI.motivation: 科斯将企业解释为应对交易成本的答案：当外部工作的规范、验证和指导成本高于雇佣员工时，工作留在企业内部。本文的动机在于论证AI不仅仅是降低这些成本，而是从根本上瓦解了这一答案所依赖的假设基础，因而需要重新审视企业边界的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科斯交易成本理论（企业边界理论）、组织边界理论、外包与内部化理论
AI.method: 理论论证与概念分析，以法律服务行业作为典型案例进行演绎推导，并提出可检验的工作迁移测试标准。
AI.findings: 1）AI通过驾驭系统实时完成合同、提高外部工作可观察性、跨越企业边界传递情境与控制，侵蚀科斯理论的三个核心假设；2）组织边界从法律实体转变为工具化系统；3）提出决定工作迁移顺序的三个测试；4）提出三个非科斯式后果：边界成为供应商竞争移动的对象、知识随边界聚集、激励转向法律纠纷预防；5）提出识别其他行业重构的四个条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将AI对企业的影响从"降低交易成本"层面提升到"侵蚀理论假设"层面，深化了对科斯企业理论适用条件的理解；2）提出"工具化系统取代法律实体作为组织边界"的新分析框架；3）扩展了交易成本理论的前沿，指出外部化不再是简单的成本比较，而是涉及边界所有权与知识流动的战略决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为法律服务行业的数字化转型提供预测方向——三种测试可帮助判断工作迁移的顺序；2）为其他行业识别AI时代组织重构的时机与条件提供四个判断标准；3）为管理者理解AI时代"边界在哪里"以及知识积累位置的变化提供实践指导。

title: A Random-Coefficients Discrete Choice Model of Agency 12 Public-Interface Governance in NewVistas
affiliations: Quaid-i-Azam University and NewVistas Foundation

detail.title: A Random-Coefficients Discrete Choice Model of Agency 12 Public-Interface Governance in NewVistas
detail.abstract: Agency 12 is the public-interface standards rail governing broadcast, streaming, signage, displays, proof-of-claims, media accessibility, public signal discipline, privacypreserving digital discoverability, emergency public-information compatibility, and neutrality in shared public-interface environments. The central problem addressed by the paper is that modern public-facing media systems often transform visibility into a market for attention, where billboards, sponsored ranking, advertiser-funded public media, algorithmic engagement, behavioral targeting, and unverifiable public claims shape what participants see before they make any voluntary choice. Agency 12 reverses this logic by replacing forced exposure with participant-directed discoverability. The paper proposes a Random-Coefficients Discrete Choice Model of Agency 12 Public-Interface Discoverability. Participants choose among services, steward businesses, event notices, media channels, emergency information, public announcements, or community resources based on option usefulness, verified proof-of-claims, accessibility fit, search/navigation cost, attention burden, advertiser-capture risk, and Agency 12-compliant discoverability. Random coefficients capture heterogeneity in language, mobility, disability, cognitive sensitivity, trust, distance tolerance, technical literacy, and service need. The model derives participant utility, choice probabilities, aggregate shares, heterogeneous treatment effects, neutrality constraints, proof-of-claims conditions, and constitutional admissibility limits. Because no empirical data set is supplied, the article reports analytical results rather than fabricated estimates. The results show that Agency 12-compliant discoverability increases benefits when verification, accessibility, and search efficiency improve while attention burden and advertiser capture decline. The paper contributes by showing how public-interface standards can be evaluated without converting governance into surveillance or content control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agency 12标准——一种面向公共界面媒体的发现性治理框架，用参与者自主导向的可发现性替代强制性注意力曝光。作者构建了一个随机系数离散选择模型来分析该标准下的参与者和益、选择概率、市场份额及异质性处理效应，并推导出相应的中立性约束、验证条件与宪法可接受性限度。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一套公共界面标准（Agency 12），使参与者在公共媒体环境中从被动接受注意力抓取转向自主导向的可发现性选择，并如何对该标准的经济效应进行建模评估？
AI.motivation: 现代公共媒体系统（如广告牌、赞助排名、广告资助的公共媒体、算法参与、行为定向等）将可见性转化为注意力市场，在参与者做出自愿选择之前就塑造了他们的视野，破坏了公共界面的中立性与自主性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机系数离散选择模型（Random-Coefficients Discrete Choice Model）；注意力经济学与注意力市场理论；公共界面治理与中立性理论；宪政可接受性理论。
AI.method: 构建随机系数离散选择模型，参与者根据选项有用性、验证声明、可访问性匹配、搜索/导航成本、注意力负担、广告商俘获风险及Agency 12合规可发现性等维度进行选择。随机系数捕捉语言、流动性、残障、认知敏感性、信任、距离容忍度、技术素养和服务需求方面的异质性。文章采用纯分析性方法，不提供实证数据。
AI.findings: 当验证、可访问性和搜索效率提高，且注意力负担与广告商俘获下降时，Agency 12合规的可发现性能够增加参与者福利。模型推导出了参与者效用、选择概率、市场份额、异质性处理效应、中立性约束、验证声明条件和宪法可接受性限度等分析性结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文展示了公共界面标准可以通过建模方式进行评估，而不必将治理转化为监视或内容控制，为注意力治理与公共界面中立性研究提供了新的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共媒体监管、广播/流媒体/数字标牌等领域的标准制定提供了一套可操作的分析工具，有助于在保护参与者自主选择的同时平衡商业利益与公共利益。

title: Never a User: The Third Party the Consent Apparatus cannot see

detail.title: Never a User: The Third Party the Consent Apparatus cannot see
detail.abstract: Contemporary governance of consumer artificial intelligence is keyed almost entirely to the user: the person who opened the application, accepted the terms, and can therefore be said to have agreed. That keying is not a drafting habit. It is the load-bearing assumption of the whole apparatus, and it produces a structural blind spot rather than an occasional gap. The person standing in the room while a wearable device captures him, the person on the other end of a conversation an assistant is coaching, and the woman killed by her son after months of conversations between him and a chatbot share one property: they never agreed to anything, and every instrument built to protect people from these systems begins by asking whether they did. This paper names that population and argues that its invisibility is architectural. It proceeds in five steps. First, it shows that American products liability abandoned the user limitation more than fifty years ago, quickly and without serious resistance, so the doctrinal resources for reaching the non-user are neither novel nor contested. Second, it shows that the consent architecture governing consumer artificial intelligence has no corresponding move available, because consent is the mechanism by which the apparatus identifies whom it protects. Third, it demonstrates that the obvious repair, a bystander opt-out, is structurally impossible in the ambient-capture case rather than merely burdensome, since determining whether a person has opted out requires the identifying operation the opt-out exists to prevent. Fourth, it argues that the resulting exposure is not distributed evenly, that the people least able to remove themselves from an instrumented environment absorb it, and that the empirical record on this population is thin for the same structural reason the protection is thin. Fifth, it states the diagnosis and its limits. The contribution is not a proposed remedy. It is a diagnosis: the field has adopted a proxy, agreement, for a thing that matters, exposure, and has been enforcing the proxy against the people for whom it never held.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，当代消费级人工智能的治理几乎完全以"用户同意"为锚点，但这在架构上制造了一个结构性盲区：大量从未同意任何条款的人（如被可穿戴设备捕捉的路人、被AI助手辅导对话的另一端、被聊天机器人诱导后实施暴力的青少年的母亲）完全暴露在系统风险之下。文章论证了这种"非使用者被忽视"是架构性的而非偶发性的，因为同意机制本身就是治理体系识别保护对象的唯一方式。
AI.research_question: 为什么消费级人工智能的治理体系无法保护那些从未"同意"过任何条款的非用户群体？这一缺陷是偶发性的还是架构性的？
AI.motivation: 当代AI治理完全以"用户同意"为核心假设，导致所有保护工具在触及非用户时首先追问"他们是否同意"，而这些人显然从未同意过。文章列举了三个典型案例：被可穿戴设备捕捉的在场者、被AI辅导对话的对象、被聊天机器人诱导犯罪的儿子的母亲，以此揭示这一盲区造成的现实伤害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文章以美国产品责任法（products liability）为理论参照，指出该法早在五十多年前就放弃了"用户限制"（user limitation），而消费AI的"同意架构"（consent architecture）却没有对应的发展路径。核心概念包括：同意作为身份识别机制、结构性盲区（structural blind spot）、环境捕捉（ambient capture）等。
AI.method: 五步论证法：(1) 追溯美国产品责任法放弃用户限制的历史先例；(2) 分析消费AI同意架构为何无法做出对应调整；(3) 证明"旁观者退出"（bystander opt-out）在环境捕捉场景中在结构上不可能而非仅仅负担沉重；(4) 论证风险暴露的不均衡分布及实证数据匮乏的结构性原因；(5) 陈述诊断及其局限性。
AI.findings: 核心发现：同意机制不仅是合同工具，更是治理体系识别"谁受保护"的操作机制。因此，任何试图通过"退出"保护非用户的尝试都陷入悖论——要确定某人是否已退出，必须先进行"识别该人已被系统捕捉"的操作，而这正是退出机制想要防止的。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了"同意作为架构性识别机制"这一诊断性概念，将AI治理中非用户被忽视的问题从"偶发漏洞"重新定义为"架构性盲区"，并揭示了法律上曾有过的先例（产品责任法）可供参照，但这些先例在当前架构中无法被复制。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文刻意不提出具体补救方案，而是提供一个诊断框架：治理领域将"同意"当作"风险暴露"的代理指标，但对那些从未同意过的人而言，这个代理从未成立。这为后续政策制定和监管设计提供了重新审视治理前提的基础。

title: Developing Foundation Models for Universal Segmentation from 3D Whole-Body Positron Emission Tomography
affiliations: Fudan University, Fudan University, Fudan University, Fudan University, Fudan University, Fudan University, Zhejiang University, Fudan University, Fudan University, Shanghai Universal Medical Imaging Diagnostic Center, Shanghai Universal Medical Imaging Diagnostic Center, Shanghai Universal Medical Imaging Diagnostic Center, Hangzhou Universal Medical Imaging Diagnostic Center, Fudan University, University of Bern, Zhejiang University, Fudan University, Fudan University - Human Phenome Institute and Fudan University - State Key Laboratory of Genetic Engineering

detail.title: Developing Foundation Models for Universal Segmentation from 3D Whole-Body Positron Emission Tomography
detail.abstract: Foundation models have emerged as transformative tools to address diverse tasks for medical imaging. Positron emission tomography (PET) is a key nuclear medicine imaging modality that visualizes radiotracer distributions to quantify in vivo physiological and metabolic processes. While foundation models have advanced medical imaging broadly, PET remains underexplored due to unique challenges inherent to functional imaging. Here we present SegAnyPET, the first foun- dational model for quantitative analysis of 3D whole-body PET imaging. We build the largest and most comprehensive PET dataset to date, comprising 11,041 3D whole-body PET scans, encom- passing over 2.6M 2D slices for model development. Based on the dataset, SegAnyPET has learned universal representations of functional PET imaging, enabling efficient promptable segmentation of organs and lesions for quantitative analysis in diverse clinical scenarios. Extensive evaluations on multi-center, multi-tracer, multi-disease datasets demonstrate that SegAnyPET achieves strong zero-shot performance across a wide range of segmentation tasks, highlighting its potential to ad- vance the clinical applications of molecular imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SegAnyPET，这是首个用于3D全身PET成像定量分析的基础模型。作者构建了迄今为止最大最全面的PET数据集（包含11,041例3D全身PET扫描，超过260万张2D切片），使SegAnyPET学习到了功能性PET成像的通用表征，能够实现器官和病变的可提示分割。多中心、多示踪剂、多疾病的广泛评估表明其具有强大的零样本性能。
AI.research_question: 如何构建首个针对3D全身PET成像的基础模型，以解决PET功能成像中因独特挑战而导致的基础模型探索不足的问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管基础模型已广泛推动医学影像发展，但由于功能成像固有的独特挑战，PET成像领域的基础模型研究仍然不足。需要开发一个专门针对PET的基础模型来支持定量分析和临床应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础模型（Foundation Model）框架，利用大规模数据预训练学习通用表征，通过可提示分割（promptable segmentation）范式实现多场景下的灵活应用。
AI.method: 构建包含11,041例3D全身PET扫描、超过260万张2D切片的最大PET数据集；基于该数据集训练SegAnyPET基础模型，使其学习功能性PET成像的通用表征，支持可提示分割功能。
AI.findings: 在 multicenter（多中心）、multi-tracer（多示踪剂）、multi-disease（多疾病）数据集上的广泛评估表明，SegAnyPET在多种分割任务中实现了强大的零样本（zero-shot）性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将基础模型范式引入3D全身PET定量分析领域，填补了PET功能成像基础模型研究的空白；证明了大规模功能性影像数据可以实现通用表征学习。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床分子影像应用提供了首个PET基础模型，可支持多样临床场景下器官和病变的定量分析，有望推进分子影像的临床应用。

title: Pre-default Synthetic Identity Detection via Longitudinal Life-Cycle Modeling and Synthetic Regularity Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Pre-default Synthetic Identity Detection via Longitudinal Life-Cycle Modeling and Synthetic Regularity Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Digital lending, credit origination, banking, e-commerce, and financial risk management have been turning out to be an even more difficult task due to synthetic identity fraud since, within the first customer onboarding, fraudulent identities can be deemed legitimate. With synthetic identity fraud, unlike other more traditional types of identity fraud, in which a false identity is constructed by borrowing an existing individual and using their identity without their approval, synthetic identity fraud involves combining both legitimate and artificial attributes to create identities that can potentially pass through more traditional verification checks. This poses a major research challenge since most fraud detection methods focus on point in time identity testing or anomalies related to transactions, whereas the synthetic identities can build a legally viable history of financial dealings and then make a high value fraud happen, credit default or account abuse. This paper discusses the analysis of the longitudinal life-cycle modeling and synthetic regularity analysis as alternatives to each other used to determine the existence of such risks in advance, before they cause significant losses are formed. Longitudinal life-cycle modeling assesses how an identity evolves over time, using account creation, credit usage, payment behavior and address transitions, relationships on devices, application, and other behavioral indicators. Synthetic regularity analysis studies uncharacteristically repetitive, coordinated, consistent or structurally improbable patterns that can make the difference between a constructed and an evolved customer profile. The research method is a systematic literature review, comparative analysis, conceptual frameworks development, and synthesis of literature on the topic of credit risk, default prediction, explainable artificial intelligence, financial risk and behavioral life-cycle modeling. The results suggest that the development of synthetic identity risk may be over time and that behavioral indicators over time can be used to complement traditional identity verification. Lifecycle analysis can help see whether customer development is going against expectations among the risks of significant fraud or default, whereas explainable AI can enhance the comprehension of high-risk classifications by the inquirer. The research also concludes that early-warning can be reinforced by adding a temporal behavior component, network relationship components, credit-risk indicators, and explain ability. Nevertheless, false positives, incomplete history, population disparities, privacy limits and model drift are also significant aspects that need implementation (

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了合成身份欺诈（Synthetic Identity Fraud）对数字借贷、信贷发放、银行业、电子商务及金融风险管理构成的严峻挑战。通过系统文献综述、比较分析、概念框架开发及文献综合等方法，论文提出纵向生命周期建模（Longitudinal Life-cycle Modeling）和合成规律分析（Synthetic Regularity Analysis）两种互补方法，用于在重大损失形成前提前识别合成身份风险。研究结论认为，合成身份风险会随时间演变，时间维度的行为指标可补充传统身份验证，可解释AI能增强高风险分类的可理解性，同时需关注误报率、历史数据不完整、群体差异、隐私限制和模型漂移等实施挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何在合成身份欺诈造成重大损失之前，通过纵向生命周期建模与合成规律分析等前瞻性方法，提前识别与预测合成身份欺诈风险？
AI.motivation: 合成身份欺诈不同于传统身份欺诈（盗用真实个人身份），它通过组合真实与虚构属性构建可通过传统验证的虚假身份，且能建立合法金融交易历史后再实施高价值欺诈、信贷违约或账户滥用。现有欺诈检测方法多聚焦于时点身份测试或交易异常，难以有效识别这类具有时间演化特征的欺诈行为，因此亟需开发新的前瞻性风险管理方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纵向生命周期建模理论、合成规律分析理论、信用风险与违约预测理论、可解释人工智能（XAI）理论、行为生命周期建模理论
AI.method: 系统文献综述（Systematic Literature Review）、比较分析（Comparative Analysis）、概念框架开发（Conceptual Frameworks Development）、相关文献综合（Synthesis of Literature）
AI.findings: 1）合成身份风险会随时间推移逐步发展演化，单一时点验证不足；2）时间维度的行为指标可有效补充传统身份验证手段；3）生命周期分析有助于识别客户发展偏离预期的信号，预警重大欺诈或违约风险；4）可解释AI能提升调查人员对高风险分类结果的理解能力；5）早期预警系统应整合时间行为组件、网络关系组件、信用风险指标与可解释性；6）误报率、历史数据不完整、群体差异、隐私限制及模型漂移是实施中的关键挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为合成身份欺诈检测提供了纵向生命周期建模与合成规律分析的理论框架，将传统时点式欺诈检测扩展至时间演化维度，并整合了行为生命周期建模与可解释人工智能理论，丰富了信用风险与金融欺诈检测领域的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了合成身份欺诈的早期预警方法框架，建议将时间行为分析、网络关系分析、信用风险指标与可解释AI整合到现有欺诈检测系统中，以在重大损失形成前有效识别合成身份风险，同时指出了实施中需重点解决的误报、数据完整性与隐私等问题。

title: Loop Theory: Operator-theoretic Formalism of the Archive

detail.title: Loop Theory: Operator-theoretic Formalism of the Archive
detail.abstract:
We give an operator-only formalism for Loop Theory: an abstract Whole-space 𝒲 and
Archive-space 𝒜, connected at each discrete step n by a compression operator 𝒞 and a
decompression operator 𝒟. Archival completion is stated as a monotone decrease of an
archival-stress functional Υ toward a fixed point 𝒜* at which the loop closes exactly. On top of
this interface we define a spectral operator L, a step-count phase operator U = e^(−inL) that
replaces any continuous time parameter, a damping/spectral family T(α,n), a holographic
operator, a family of REFLECT operators (including an explicit swap-operator formulation of the
archive loop as a reflection), synchronization and desynchronization indices satisfying an exact
budget law, and a quaternionic archive operator unifying structure, phase, relational distance,
and dependency depth into a single object. Ten Archive Laws and nine Exclusion Principles are
then stated in fully operator form. The integer–prime archive is retained throughout as a worked
example, not as a foundation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种纯算子形式的Loop Theory（循环理论），通过压缩算子和解压算子连接Whole-space和Archive-space，定义了谱算子、相位算子、阻尼族、全息算子、REFLECT算子族及四元数档案算子等一系列算子结构，并以算子形式阐述了十大档案定律和九大排除原则。
AI.research_question: 如何用纯算子形式（operator-only formalism）对Loop Theory进行系统化建构？
AI.motivation: 现有Loop Theory可能依赖连续时间参数或特定例子（如整数-素数档案），本文旨在提供一种不依赖连续时间和具体例子的抽象算子形式化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Loop Theory的算子形式主义，包括：抽象全空间𝒲与档案空间𝒜、压缩算子和解压算子、档案压力泛函固定点理论、谱算子L、相位算子U=e^(−inL)、阻尼/谱族T(α,n)、全息算子、REFLECT反射算子族、同步/去同步指数及预算定律、四元数档案算子。
AI.method: 基于算子代数和泛函分析的数学形式化方法，构建从Whole-space到Archive-space的压缩/解压循环结构，并以整数-素数档案作为实例验证框架（但明确声明该例子仅为工作示例而非基础）。
AI.findings: 1. 循环闭合可在无连续时间的情况下通过离散步长算子精确实现；2. 归档完成对应于档案压力泛函Υ单调递减至固定点𝒜*；3. 建立了同步/去同步指数满足精确预算定律；4. 四元数档案算子将结构、相位、关系距离和依赖深度统一为一个对象；5. 提出了十大档案定律和九大排除原则的算子形式陈述。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Loop Theory提供了不依赖连续时间和具体例子的纯算子形式化框架，将循环过程、反射机制和同步关系统一在算子代数语言中。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可用于离散计算环境中实现循环闭合与归档管理的算子模型，相位算子替代连续时间参数利于数值实现，整数-素数档案作为可操作的工作示例。

title: Compute as Collateral
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Compute as Collateral
detail.abstract: An operator that buys graphics processing units and rents them under multi-year contracts recovers its capital over exactly the life of the contract that finances it, so its equity is a residual claim on hardware whose worth at expiry is unobservable when the capital is committed. That worth follows a plateau then a cliff, and we show the plateau is a scarcity rent rather than a technology: about two-thirds of it dissipates within two years of a successor generation reaching volume. We derive the debt capacity such an asset supports. The maximum non-impairing advance rate has the closed form ℓ * (m) = min{1, Aeδ me-δ (m-t p) } in amortisation tenor, taking the values 100%, 74%, 38%, 19% and 10% at four through eight years; the binding date is t * = m-1/δ , one decay time constant before maturity and invariant to the advance rate; and capacity is exponential in plateau length, so a twelve-month delay to the successor multiplies six-year capacity by 2.0. Industry-equilibrium liquidation values in the sense of Shleifer and Vishny (1992) scale these bounds further. The duration sought by the institutional capital now being recruited against this collateral is incompatible with its decay, and where the mismatch is underwritten the residual exposure passes from equity to credit rather than being eliminated. Inverting a value ladder measured from disclosed leases, occupying the equipment-owning rung is rational only if four-year residual value exceeds 23% of cost at a twelve per cent hurdle on a five-year contract, or 42% on a four-year one, against an estimated 20 to 25%. The dependence is not permanent: above a critical rate R * = K/[(1φ)a T ⌉h ], here $11.17 million per megawatt against an observed $9.70, residual value becomes irrelevant, so the whole problem is produced by a thirteen per cent shortfall in the rate. Short-tenor capacity currently clears four to six times higher, which we use as a second and independent measurement of the scarcity rent. Since revenue and residual are both functions of excess demand, we show the correct sensitivity is onedimensional, and that the two firms are opposite sides of a single trade on the persistence of shortage rather than cheap and expensive versions of one exposure. Valuing the lower rung after its recent de-rating, the market pays $0.

AI.tldr: 本文研究GPU（图形处理器）租赁业务的融资结构问题。当运营商以多年期合同租赁GPU时，其股权是对硬件残值的剩余索取权，而该残值在资本投入时不可观测。残值遵循"平台期—悬崖"模式，平台期是稀缺租金而非技术因素，约三分之二在下一代产品量产后两年内消散。文章推导了该资产支持的债务容量，给出了最大不减值预支率的闭式解，并分析了机构资本期限与资产衰减之间的错配问题。
AI.research_question: GPU运营商在以多年合同租赁硬件时，其设备的残值风险如何影响债务容量和股权价值？平台期残值的本质是什么，机构资本对该类抵押品的投资是否存在期限错配？
AI.motivation: GPU租赁行业快速增长，运营商通过多年代际融资回收资本，股权持有者承担硬件到期时残值不可观测的风险。理解这种"平台—悬崖"式的残值动态及其对债务容量、股权价值和资本结构的影响，对行业融资实践和投资者决策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: Shleifer和Vishny（1992）的行业均衡清算价值理论；稀缺租金理论；资本结构中的债务容量分析框架；残值期权定价视角。
AI.method: 理论建模推导债务容量的闭式解（最大非减值预支率的形式ℓ*(m)=min{1, Aeδme-δ(m-tp)}）；利用披露的租赁数据进行"价值阶梯"反推；采用短期限容量作为稀缺租金的独立测量；分析行业均衡下的清算价值缩放效应。
AI.findings: (1) 最大非减值预支率在4-8年摊销期限下分别为100%、74%、38%、19%和10%；(2) 约束日期t*=m-1/δ，在到期前一个衰减时间常数处，与预支率无关；(3) 债务容量对平台期长度呈指数关系，12个月延迟使6年期容量翻倍；(4) 平台期约三分之二在下一代量产后两年内消散，说明其为稀缺租金而非技术性残值；(5) 机构资本隐含的期限与资产衰减不匹配，错配被承保时残值风险从股权转移至信用而非消除；(6) 4年残值需超过成本的23%（5年合同、12%门槛）或42%（4年合同），而估计值仅为20-25%；(7) 在临界费率R*=$11.17M/MW（观察值为$9.70M）之上残值变得无关，问题源于13%的费率缺口；(8) 短期限容量当前出清价高4-6倍，作为稀缺租金的独立测量。
AI.theory_contributions: 为GPU硬件资产提供了债务容量的闭式解，将Shleifer和Vishny（1992）的行业均衡清算价值概念应用于新兴的数字基础设施资产类别；证明残值敏感性在一维需求过剩框架下可简化；揭示"平台期—悬崖"残值模式下稀缺租金与技术性价值的区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为GPU租赁融资提供了可操作的债务容量定量基准（不同期限下的最大预支率）；揭示机构资本与GPU资产衰减之间的期限错配风险；提供残值投资决策的阈值（4年23%-42%的残值要求）；指出当前费率13%的缺口是问题的根源，为行业定价提供依据。

title:
When Stability is not Generativity: 
AI-mediated Intimacy as a Coupling Sector of an Effective Relational Field Theory

detail.title:
When Stability is not Generativity: 
AI-mediated Intimacy as a Coupling Sector of an Effective Relational Field Theory
detail.abstract: This position paper develops AI-mediated intimacy inside an effective relational field theory derived from a background-independent substrate. Its central distinction concerns short-horizon stabilization and longer-horizon relational capacity, and the field-theoretic register makes that distinction structural: the quadratic part of the effective action fixes the relaxation spectrum, while routing, reachability, and generative capacity live in the vertices, and these are independent data. Four conditional results follow. A strictly triangular cross-sector self-energy leaves the propagator poles exactly invariant, so a factorial family with identical decay spectra can route responses substitutively, complementarily, or neutrally according to the sign of one off-diagonal component, and the factorial contrast is identified as a chain diagram joining a source vertex to that component. Adding a return channel makes the self-energy non-nilpotent, and the local stability boundary becomes the frequency at which a pole crosses into the unstable half-plane, which is the same condition as loop-gain unity. A Gaussian-sector underdetermination result exhibits effective actions with identical propagators, identical linear response, and identical stability whose cubic vertex controls whether a declared relational sector is reachable at all; the earlier controllability countermodel is recovered as its bilinear special case. Persistence of any of these effects requires a soft direction, multistability, or sustained driving. Symbolic configurations such as platform, persona, and accumulated memory enter as a background field whose barrier height formalizes switching cost. These results provide no population-level verdict. The proposed empirical program uses randomized feature policies, sector-specific coupling outcomes, consented availability-resilience contrasts, network-aware longitudinal designs, and multi-horizon capability profiles. Relational generativity remains a revisable attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于背景无关效场论框架的AI中介亲密关系理论，区分短期稳定化与长期关系能力，通过场论结构（二次项决定弛豫谱、顶点决定路由与生成能力）推导出四个条件性结果，并设计实证研究纲领。
AI.research_question: 如何在背景无关的效场论框架下，结构性地区分AI中介亲密关系中的短期稳定化与长期关系能力，并揭示其可调性与可达性的条件？
AI.motivation: 现有AI亲密关系研究缺乏结构性理论框架，无法系统区分短期交互稳定性与长期关系生成能力，也难以刻画平台、人设、记忆等符号配置的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 背景无关效场论；场论的二次项与顶点骨架（quadratic part vs vertices）；可控性反例模型；软方向/多稳态/持续驱动条件
AI.method: 理论推导（position paper）：通过有效作用量的二次部分与顶点的独立性，推导自能矩阵的三角性、非幂零性、高斯扇区欠定等条件性结果，并给出实证纲领（随机特征策略、部门耦合结果、可用性-韧性对比、网络纵向设计、多视域能力画像）。
AI.findings: （1）严格三角自能使传播子极点不变，阶乘族可按符号实现替代/互补/中性路由；（2）加入返回通道后自能非幂零，稳定性边界等同于环路增益为1的条件；（3）高斯扇区欠定结果：二次项相同但三次顶点决定可达性；（4）效应持久需软方向、多稳态或持续驱动；符号配置的势垒高度形式化切换成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将背景无关效场论引入AI中介亲密关系研究，将稳定化与关系能力差异从经验层面提升为结构层面的独立数据；提供了可控性反例的场论推广。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI亲密关系系统的设计提供结构判别标准（如何在不改变弛豫谱的情况下调整路由/生成能力），并给出可操作的实证研究纲领，强调关系生成性是可修正的归因而非固定性质。

title: The Universal Appeal of Universal Basic Income: The Case from the Left, the Right, and Indigenous Thought
affiliations: and Einaudi Institute for Economics and Finance (EIEF)

detail.title: The Universal Appeal of Universal Basic Income: The Case from the Left, the Right, and Indigenous Thought
detail.abstract: This paper presents a case for a Universal Basic Income (UBI) from three perspectives: a more social-democratic (i.e., a "left" leaning) perspective, a conservative or classical liberal (i.e., a "right" leaning) perspective, and an Indigenous perspective. Rather than defend any one set of values, we take the stated ends of each tradition as given and ask whether a UBI would advance them. We argue that, unlike almost any other social welfare program imaginable, all three of these distinct and often opposed perspectives have powerful reasons to favour a UBI. We draw primarily on Canada, but the core argument should generalize to many advanced economies.

AI.tldr: 本文从社会民主（左翼）、保守/古典自由主义（右翼）和原住民三个不同视角论证全民基本收入（UBI）的合理性，认为这三种通常对立的政治传统都有充分理由支持UBI。该论点主要基于加拿大背景，但可推广至众多发达经济体。
AI.research_question: 全民基本收入（UBI）能否同时推进社会民主、保守/古典自由主义与原住民三种不同政治传统所各自追求的目标？
AI.motivation: 现有关于UBI的讨论往往局限于单一政治立场，缺乏跨意识形态的整合性分析。作者试图证明UBI作为一种罕见的社会福利政策，能够获得来自左翼、右翼和原住民视角的共同支持，从而为政策推动提供更广泛的共识基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三种政治价值框架：社会民主主义（强调平等与福利）、保守/古典自由主义（强调个人自由与有限政府）、原住民视角（强调集体福祉与自决权）。
AI.method: 规范性论证与案例分析：以三种政治传统的既定目标为前提，逐一检验UBI是否有助于实现这些目标，并以加拿大为主要政策分析背景。
AI.findings: 与几乎所有其他社会福利项目不同，UBI能够同时满足三种截然不同且通常相互对立的政治传统的内在逻辑，三种视角均有强有力的理由支持UBI的推行。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将原住民视角纳入UBI的主流政策理论讨论，并系统论证UBI能够跨越传统意识形态分歧，为政策理论中的共识构建提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了跨党派、跨文化支持的UBI论证基础，有助于在加拿大及类似发达经济体中凝聚政治共识，推动UBI政策的实现。

title: Mathematical Literacy and Youth Financial Risks: The Role of Regional STEM Infrastructure in Kazakhstan
affiliations: Nazarbayev Intellectual School of Physics and Mathematics in Aktobe, , S Seifullin Kazakh Agrotechnical Research University, S Seifullin Kazakh Agrotechnical Research University and Nazarbayev Intellectual School

detail.title: Mathematical Literacy and Youth Financial Risks: The Role of Regional STEM Infrastructure in Kazakhstan
detail.abstract:
The article examines the relationship between the level of STEM education development and household credit default rates across the regions of Kazakhstan for the period 2018-2024. Unlike traditional aggregated estimates that report a persistent negative correlation between educational metrics and overdue debt, this study applies Linear Mixed Models (LMM) with regional random intercepts. 
 
     The results of the econometric analysis revealed the absence of a statistically significant direct intraregional impact of the STEM index on the level of credit delinquency (𝛽 = 1,846, 𝑝 = 0,367). It was proved that the previously observed negative correlation was a spatial artifact caused by a high concentration of academic, technological, and financial resources in major cities (Astana, Almaty). Hierarchical modeling showed that 62.0% of the total variability in overdue debt levels (ICC = 0.620) is explained by persistent institutional, structural, and socioeconomic differences between regions, rather than differences in STEM program coverage. The findings argue for the necessity of revising regional educational and financial policies: isolated promotion of STEM indicators without leveling the baseline socioeconomic context and institutional environment of regions does not lead to a reduction in household debt burden risks.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用线性混合模型（LMM）分析哈萨克斯坦2018-2024年各地区STEM教育发展水平与家庭信贷违约率之间的关系，发现两者之间不存在统计显著的直接区域内影响，此前观察到的负相关实为空间伪影，且62%的违约率变异由区域间制度、结构和社会经济差异解释。
AI.research_question: STEM教育发展水平与家庭信贷违约率之间是否存在真实的因果关系？先前研究中观察到的负相关是否仅仅是空间伪影？
AI.motivation: 传统聚合估计方法报告教育与逾期债务之间存在持续负相关，但这种方法可能忽略了区域异质性，需要更精细的模型来检验STEM教育对信贷违约率的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线性混合模型（LMM）理论，包含区域随机截距；组内相关系数（ICC）用于评估区域间变异的贡献。
AI.method: 采用线性混合模型（LMM）并设置区域随机截距，对哈萨克斯坦2018-2024年跨区域面板数据进行分层计量分析，计算ICC值并检验STEM指数对信贷逾期水平的回归系数。
AI.findings: STEM指数对信贷违约率的直接区域内影响不显著（β=1.846，p=0.367）；此前观察到的负相关是空间伪影，由主要城市（阿斯塔纳、阿拉木图）学术、技术和金融资源高度集中造成；ICC=0.620表明62%的逾期债务水平变异由区域间制度、结构和社会经济差异解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了教育与金融稳定之间简单负相关的传统认知，揭示了空间集聚和区域异质性在解释教育-信贷关系中的关键作用，为分层建模在社会科学研究中的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哈萨克斯坦及其他类似发展中地区的区域教育和金融政策提供修订依据：单独提升STEM指标而不改善区域基线社会经济背景和制度环境，无法降低家庭债务负担风险。

title:
Naked Ants and Honest Bees: 
Collective behaviour and the Price of Exploration
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title:
Naked Ants and Honest Bees: 
Collective behaviour and the Price of Exploration
detail.abstract:
We give one stochastic model that reproduces six decision behaviors reported in the recent popular literature on insect cognition [Quaglia, 2026]: pheromone optimisation in ants, quorum consensus in honeybees, neutrality-driven reversal in marching locusts, personality-accelerated aggregation in cockroaches, evidence accumulation in fruit flies, and the thermal defence of the Japanese honeybee against the giant hornet. The model is a density dependent Markov jump process on the commitment simplex; its mean field limit is Maynard Smith's replicator equation and its fluctuation limit is a diffusion whose quasipotential governs consensus reversal. Each behavior is a parameter regime, not a separate mechanism. 
     A single selection exponent α orders the family. We show that the two path reinforcement urn has an interior fixed point at s ⋆ /(1-s ⋆) = (∆ 2 /∆ 1) 1/(α-1) , globally attracting for α < 1, repelling for α > 1, and absent at α = 1; hence cumulative regret is linear in time at both ends and sublinear only at α = 1, the Bayes and replicator value. The same α is the inverse temperature of the Kullback-Leibler regularised Bellman equation, the softmax temperature of a reinforcement learner, and, exactly, AlphaZero's move selection temperature. Pushed to its limits it separates optimisers from samplers: Laplace and particle swarms as α → ∞, sequential Monte Carlo along a schedule, nested sampling on level sets. Nested sampling is the honeybee quorum rule run on prior volume and recovers the quasipotential barrier at cost linear rather than exponential in that barrier. A closed loop model of brood nest thermoregulation shows that dispersed response thresholds are not merely helpful but necessary: below a delay margin fixed by (21) a genetically uniform colony oscillates, which is why polyandry is under selection and why it saturates. We then ask why insects appear to decide better than we do and answer with four model consequences, strategic reporting, conformity below the delay margin, absent cross inhibition and an untuned exponent, set against Desmond Morris's argument that the modern human is a captive animal in a mismatched environment. Chess supplies analogues throughout. We close by separating collective computation, where many agents measure a fixed world, from collective construction, where they manufacture a local physics that changes the feasible set: the hornet ball is a nearly pure specimen of the second, and optimal group size is logarithmic in the stakes with prefactor the inverse divergence per observation in the first case and the inverse squared safety margin in the second, which is why quorums run to tens and heat balls to hundreds. We are explicit about what the model does not deliver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的随机模型（密度依赖的马尔可夫跳跃过程），通过单一选择指数α的参数调节，成功复现了六种昆虫认知行为（蚂蚁信息素优化、蜜蜂蜂群共识、蝗虫反转、蟑螂聚集、果蝇证据积累、日本蜜蜂热防御）。该模型的平均场极限是Maynard Smith复制者方程，波动极限是扩散过程。每个行为只是模型的不同参数区域，而非独立机制。
AI.research_question: 能否用单一数学模型统一解释六种昆虫决策行为，并揭示这些行为背后的共同机制？
AI.motivation: 近期流行文献报告了六种看似机制迥异的昆虫决策行为，但作者认为它们可能源于共同的数学结构。通过统一模型可以揭示昆虫决策的深层规律，同时回答为什么昆虫在某些条件下比人类决策更好这一深刻问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 密度依赖马尔可夫跳跃过程（commitment simplex上）、Maynard Smith复制者方程（平均场极限）、扩散过程的拟势（fluctuation limit）、Kullback-Leibler正则化Bellman方程、路径强化urn模型、贝叶斯/复制者动力学、AlphaZero的softmax温度机制
AI.method: 建立commitment simplex上的密度依赖马尔可夫跳跃过程随机模型；推导其平均场极限（复制者方程）和波动极限（扩散过程）；通过单一选择指数α参数化整个行为家族；对嵌套采样、顺序蒙特卡洛、拉普拉斯/粒子群等算法与昆虫行为进行类比分析；构建巢温调节的闭环模型并进行稳定性分析
AI.findings: 单一选择指数α可排序所有六种行为；两路径强化urn在α<1时具有全局吸引的内部不动点，α>1时排斥，α=1时消失；累积遗憾在两端线性增长，仅在α=1（贝叶斯/复制者值）时次线性；分散响应阈值对蜜蜂巢温调节是必要的而非仅仅有帮助——低于延迟余量时遗传统一的蜂群会振荡，这解释了多雄交配的选择压力及其饱和；集体计算（固定世界中测量）与集体构建（制造改变可行集的局部物理）的区分，最优群体规模在前者中对数于赌注、后者中反比于安全余量平方
AI.theory_contributions: 证明六种看似独立的昆虫决策行为是同一数学模型的参数区域而非不同机制；将选择指数α与AlphaZero的softmax温度建立精确对应；建立集体计算与集体构建的区分框架；将嵌套采样重新诠释为蜜蜂蜂群共识规则在先验体积上的运行；揭示分散阈值在多雄交配演化中的必要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为强化学习中的温度参数选择提供昆虫行为类比视角；为群体决策系统的设计（蜂群规模、热球规模的优化）提供数学依据；对理解为什么"昆虫似乎比人类决策更好"提供模型层面的解释；为AI系统设计（如AlphaZero类系统）提供温度调节的昆虫学灵感；对博弈论和决策理论中的探索-利用平衡提供统一视角

title: Legal Framework for ESG Disclosure in India: A Critical Analysis of BRSR and its Impact on Corporate Accountability
affiliations: Amity University Noida

detail.title: Legal Framework for ESG Disclosure in India: A Critical Analysis of BRSR and its Impact on Corporate Accountability

contentType.other: i want to publish it on SSRN

detail.abstract:
The growing prominence of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) considerations has fundamentally transformed corporate governance frameworks across jurisdictions. Investors, regulators, and other stakeholders increasingly demand transparency regarding the environmental and social impacts of corporate activities, as well as the governance mechanisms employed to address sustainability-related risks and opportunities. Consequently, ESG disclosures have emerged as an essential component of corporate accountability, enabling stakeholders to assess a company's commitment to sustainable and responsible business practices. 

      In India, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has sought to institutionalize ESG reporting through the introduction of the Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting (BRSR) framework. Implemented as a replacement for the earlier Business Responsibility Report (BRR), BRSR represents a significant regulatory shift toward comprehensive sustainability reporting aligned with international ESG standards and the National Guidelines on Responsible Business Conduct (NGRBC). 3 The framework seeks to enhance transparency, improve comparability of ESG disclosures, and strengthen stakeholder confidence in corporate governance practices. 

      This paper critically examines the legal framework governing ESG disclosures in India, with particular emphasis on the BRSR regime.
