Additive STPU made things worse every time we tried it. The reason turns out to be a simple numbers problem: the penalty we subtract is 2-5× larger in scale than the scores themselves, so the penalty takes over and we end up targeting the wrong people entirely. Multiplicative STPU fixes the scale problem but shows no consistent improvement across 567 experiments. It helped about as often as a coin flip. The deeper reason neither approach works is that at a 5% conversion rate, fewer than 7% of users actually benefit from an ad on any given day. Even a perfect model could only reduce budget waste to 78%, and the best real models sit at 86-92%. That remaining gap can't be closed by re-ranking, because there isn't enough signal in binary (yes/no) conversion data to reliably pick out those rare responsive users. Fixing budget waste requires richer data, such as revenue per user or multiple touchpoints per user. Smarter sorting of noisy binary signals won't get you there.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了两种针对"必然购买者"浪费广告预算问题的修复方案（加性STPU和乘性STPU），发现两者均无法有效改善目标定位效率。加性STPU因惩罚项规模远大于分数本身而完全失效；乘性STPU虽解决了规模问题但在567次实验中表现如同抛硬币。根本原因在于低转化率下真正受广告影响的用户极少，二进制转化数据无法提供足够信号来识别这些稀有响应者。
AI.research_question: 能否通过对高自发购买概率用户降低评分（Sure-Thing Penalized Uplift, STPU）来修复广告投放中的预算浪费问题？
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现标准模型浪费86-92%的目标定位预算给那些即使没有广告也会购买的用户，且提高模型准确性无法解决此问题。本文旨在测试一种自然的修复方案：通过惩罚高自发购买概率用户来优化目标定位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提升建模（Uplift Modeling）；Sure-Thing原则；广告增量效果理论
AI.method: 提出两种STPU变体：(1)加性STPU——从评分中减去惩罚值；(2)乘性STPU——按用户剩余可被影响的空间乘以评分。通过大规模实验验证（567次实验）两种方法的有效性。
AI.findings: (1)加性STPU在所有尝试中都使效果恶化，原因是惩罚项规模比分数本身大2-5倍，导致定位完全错误；(2)乘性STPU解决了规模问题但无一致改进，效果接近抛硬币；(3)在5%转化率下，每天只有不到7%的用户真正受益于广告；即使完美模型也只能将预算浪费降至78%，最佳真实模型仍在86-92%。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明重排序（re-ranking）无法解决广告预算浪费问题的理论局限；指出在低转化率场景下，二进制转化数据的信息量不足以支撑可靠的增量响应识别。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议放弃通过更聪明的排序算法解决预算浪费的思路；指出需要更丰富的数据（如每用户收入或多触点数据）才能实质性改善广告定位效率。

title: Smart Solar-Powered Warehouses: A Sustainable Approach to the Supply Chain Industry
affiliations: Christ University and Jain (Deemed to be University)

detail.title: Smart Solar-Powered Warehouses: A Sustainable Approach to the Supply Chain Industry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA.
declarations.funderStatement: NA.

detail.abstract: The rapid growth of global supply chains has intensified the demand for energy-efficient and sustainable warehouse solutions. Warehouses, traditionally known for high energy consumption, are now transforming into smart, solar-powered hubs integrating advanced sensorbased lighting and automation technologies. This paper investigates how combining solar photovoltaic (PV) systems with smart lighting controls and IoT-enabled energy management can significantly reduce operational costs, enhance environmental performance, and improve operational resilience. The study highlights the potential for such integration to support corporate sustainability goals, meet ESG compliance requirements, and align with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Using a mixed-method approach, including industry case studies and performance data analysis, this paper proposes a scalable framework for implementing smart solar-powered warehouses in the logistics sector.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将太阳能光伏系统、智能照明控制和物联网能源管理相结合应用于仓储设施，以实现降低运营成本、改善环境绩效和提升运营韧性的目标，并提出一个可扩展的实施框架。
AI.research_question: 如何通过将太阳能光伏系统与智能照明控制和物联网能源管理相结合，显著降低仓储运营成本、提升环境绩效并增强运营韧性？
AI.motivation: 全球供应链快速增长加剧了对节能和可持续仓储解决方案的需求；传统仓库能耗高，亟待向智能、太阳能驱动的绿色仓储转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论、企业ESG合规框架、联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs）以及智能能源管理理论。
AI.method: 混合研究方法，包括行业案例研究和绩效数据分析。
AI.findings: 太阳能光伏与智能照明控制和物联网能源管理的整合能够显著降低运营成本、增强环境绩效并提升运营韧性，同时支持企业可持续发展目标、满足ESG合规要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个可扩展的智能太阳能仓库实施框架，丰富了物流领域绿色能源与智能技术整合的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物流行业提供智能太阳能仓库的可落地方案框架，帮助企业降低成本、满足ESG合规要求并推动可持续发展目标的实现。

title: Does Economic Freedom Cause Development in Latin America? Abrupt Reforms, Counterfactual Panels, Orthogonal Machine Learning, and Adversarial Identification

detail.title: Does Economic Freedom Cause Development in Latin America? Abrupt Reforms, Counterfactual Panels, Orthogonal Machine Learning, and Adversarial Identification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. The research relies exclusively on publicly available, secondary, aggregate country-level data and does not involve human participants, interventions, personally identifiable information, or individual-level confidential data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The research was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
This paper tests whether changes in measured economic freedom cause development outcomes in Latin America rather than merely covary with them. The empirical object is a harmonized LATAM-11 country-year panel combining Economic Freedom of the World (EFW), the Heritage Index, World Development Indicators, the Worldwide Governance Indicators, Penn World Table 11.0, the Global Macro Database, and World Bank commodity prices. The analysis separates aggregate freedom, market-oriented policy, government size, state capacity, and state efficiency. It also expands the outcome space from growth, inequality, poverty, health, and productivity to mortality, alternative poverty thresholds, human capital, investment, trade, inflation, unemployment, education, health spending, taxation, government consumption, and state capability. Identification is deliberately triangulated. Baseline two-way fixed effects, long differences, five-year forward outcomes, local projections, synthetic controls, weak-IV diagnostics, leave-one-country-out tests, and specification curves are supplemented by abrupt-reform event designs based on isolated positive and negative changes, matched contemporaneous counterfactuals, nonnegative synthetic event controls, synthetic difference-indifferences , low-rank matrix-completion counterfactuals, event-year reassignment inference, pseudo-event dates, dependence-preserving circular shifts, leave-one-event-out deletion, threshold perturbations, random-component-index placebos, expanded sample restrictions, country-specific trends, temporal negative controls, event-definition grids, shock-timing predictability diagnostics, double/debiased machine learning with six nuisance-learning architectures and a Super Learner, machine-learning augmented inverse-probability weighting for abrupt shocks, R-learning for heterogeneous continuous effects, and T-, X-, DR-, and R-meta-learners for large positive and negative annual changes. The stronger battery, including 29 additional WDI mechanism outcomes and 145 additional outcome-by-driver tests, does not produce a stable causal coefficient for aggregate economic freedom. Some conventional or machine-learning specifications yield nominally significant coefficients, but they fail multiplicity, overlap, event-randomization, sign-stability, alternative-treatment, or alternative-counterfactual tests. Abrupt EFW rises and falls are especially informative because their post-event paths are not mirror images: apparent gains after falls and losses after rises coexist with small event counts and weak reassignment evidence. State capacity and efficiency occasionally produce suggestive signals, but the signs disagree across matched-event, DML, and AIPW designs. The central conclusion is therefore not that markets or states are irrelevant. It is that composite institutional indices are too heterogeneous and too endogenous to support a single causal development coefficient in this regional panel. The empirically defensible unit of policy analysis is the specific reform,
mechanism, implementation environment, and counterfactual.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多重识别策略检验经济自由指数变化对拉丁美洲发展结果的因果效应，发现综合制度指数过于异质且内生，无法在该区域面板中产生稳定的因果系数。
AI.research_question: 经济自由度的测量变化是否真正导致拉丁美洲的发展结果改善，还是仅仅与这些结果共变？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多依赖经济自由指数与发展结果的相关性，缺乏严格的因果识别。本文试图通过多种识别策略检验合成的制度指数能否支撑单一的因果发展系数。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济自由理论、制度经济学、国家能力理论、市场导向政策理论
AI.method: 多重三角化识别策略：双向固定效应、长差分、五年前瞻结果、局部投影、合成控制、弱工具变量诊断、逐国剔除检验、规格曲线、突变改革事件设计、合成双重差分、低秩矩阵补全反事实、双重/去偏机器学习（六种扰动学习架构+超级学习器）、机器学习增强的逆概率加权、R学习、T/X/DR/R元学习器等。
AI.findings: 综合经济自由指数无法产生稳定的因果系数。部分常规或机器学习规格产生名义上显著的系数，但未通过多重性、重叠、事件随机化、符号稳定性等检验。经济自由的急剧上升和下降的后事件路径不对称。国家能力和效率偶尔产生暗示性信号，但各设计间符号不一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了综合制度指数能够支撑单一因果发展系数的假设，指出复合制度指数过于异质和内生，理论分析单元应聚焦于具体改革而非综合指数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据：政策分析应以具体改革、机制、实施环境和反事实为单位，而非依赖综合经济自由指数进行因果推断。

title: How much AI Talk Matters

detail.title: How much AI Talk Matters

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper replicates and extends Lee and Hoffman (2025) by replacing human participants with large language model (LLM) agents in a repeated Bertrand oligopoly with varied cheap talk frequencies. Three agents compete over 30 rounds in one of four configurations, a heterogeneous market (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash) and three homogeneous markets composed of three independent instances of a single model, across six communication frequency conditions, with 20 independent groups per cell (480 groups in total). We confirm two replication results: communication rounds yield higher prices than non-communication rounds in the heterogeneous and homogeneous-Gemini configurations, and all communication treatments exceed the no-communication baseline in every configuration. Two novel results emerge. First, the homogeneity coordination premium is model-specific rather than universal. Homogeneous Claude and Gemini markets price substantially above the heterogeneous market in all six treatments, including the nocommunication control, with a gap that is statistically constant across conditions; homogeneous GPT-4o markets are indistinguishable from the heterogeneous market in every treatment. Homogeneous Claude markets are the most collusive without communication: the three identical agents submit exactly identical prices in a majority of rounds, and in four of twenty no-communication groups prices ratchet upward in lockstep from 33 to nearly 90. Second, within the heterogeneous configuration, Gemini applies a systematic single-unit undercutting rule in 38.4 percent of rounds, generating a win rate of 96.1 percent against competitors with similar average submitted prices. An exploratory finding documents a rank reversal: every-other-round communication ranks first for human participants but last for LLM heterogeneous agents. These results imply that collusion risk in AI pricing markets depends on which models are deployed and whether competitors deploy the same one, not only on communication architecture or provider diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过用大语言模型代理替代人类参与者，复现并扩展了Lee和Hoffman (2025)在重复Bertrand寡头垄断中的研究，包含异质市场（三种不同模型）和同质市场（同一模型的三个独立实例）共四种配置、六种沟通频率条件、480组实验。确认了两个复现结果，并发现了两个新结果：同质性协调溢价是模型特定的而非普遍的（同质Claude和Gemini市场定价显著高于异质市场，但GPT-4o同质市场与异质市场无差异）；异质市场中Gemini系统性地采用单单位削价规则，胜率达96.1%。另发现沟通频率排名反转的探索性结果。
AI.research_question: 用LLM代理替代人类参与者时，不同模型的同质/异质市场配置和沟通频率如何影响Bertrand寡头垄断中的合谋行为？
AI.motivation: 先前研究（Lee和Hoffman 2025）用人类参与者研究了沟通对合谋的影响，但未探讨AI代理市场中的合谋风险。随着AI定价代理在经济中的日益普及，需要理解不同模型部署（同质vs异质）和沟通频率如何影响AI市场的合谋倾向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重复Bertrand寡头垄断理论、博弈论中的沟通（cheap talk）与合谋理论；该框架基于价格竞争和默契合谋的博弈论模型。
AI.method: 大规模实验设计：三种LLM（Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash）作为代理，四组配置（1个异质+3个同质），六种沟通频率条件，每种条件20个独立组，共480组；每组30轮重复Bertrand博弈。采用复现验证和扩展分析的方法。
AI.findings: 1) 复现了沟通轮次价格高于非沟通轮次（异质和同质Gemini配置），且所有沟通处理均超过无沟通基线。2) 同质性协调溢价具有模型特定性：同质Claude和Gemini市场在所有六个处理（包括无沟通控制）中定价显著高于异质市场，且差距在不同条件下统计上恒定；同质GPT-4o市场与异质市场无差异。3) 无沟通条件下，同质Claude市场最易合谋：三代理多数轮次提交完全相同价格，20组中4组的无沟通组价格以33联动上升至接近90。4) 异质配置中，Gemini在38.4%的轮次采用系统性单单位削价规则，对价格相近的竞争对手胜率达96.1%。5) 探索性发现：每隔一轮沟通对人类参与者排名第一，但对LLM异质代理排名最后（排名反转）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI代理市场的合谋风险不仅取决于沟通架构或供应商多样性，还取决于具体部署哪些模型以及竞争对手是否部署相同模型；表明同质性协调溢价是模型特定的而非普遍规律，挑战了将AI代理视为同质行为体的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者评估AI定价市场的合谋风险提供了关键依据：反垄断监管需要考虑模型中微妙的策略行为（如Gemini的单单位削价策略），且同质市场部署方式可能带来更高的合谋风险，但需因模型而异。

title: Exchange Rate Volatility and Forecasting: Structural Breaks and Modelling of the Ghana Cedi-US Dollar Exchange Rate
affiliations: and Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Exchange Rate Volatility and Forecasting: Structural Breaks and Modelling of the Ghana Cedi-US Dollar Exchange Rate

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors of thie paper have no declaration of interest
declarations.funderStatement: This research had no funder

detail.abstract:
Persistent instability in the Ghana Cedi to United States dollar exchange rate af-
fects inflation, trade, investment, and monetary policy in Ghana. This study looks
at the presence and effects of structural breaks in the exchange rate series. It evalu-
ates the forecasting performance of three modeling approaches: ARIMA, Prophet, and
Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The analysis aims to identify structural breaks,
determine their timing and nature, and assess how instabilities impact forecast ac-
curacy. Results from the Bai-Perron multiple structural break test and the Iterated
Cumulative Sum of Squares (ICSS) test confirm the existence of structural changes in
both the mean and volatility of the series. Further change point analysis using binary
segmentation identifies multiple shifts in the mean and variance, which align with ma-
jor macroeconomic shocks and monetary policy changes. Forecast evaluation shows
that the Prophet model outperformed the ARIMA and LSTM models, recording the lowest error measures (MAE = 1.80, MSE = 3.73, RMSE = 1.93) and producing more
accurate forecasts. Although the LSTM model displayed moderate predictive perfor-
mance, the ARIMA model performed relatively poorly. The findings emphasize the
need to consider structural breaks in exchange rate modeling and forecasting. They
also provide useful insights for policymakers, investors, and businesses in managing
exchange rate uncertainty and risk.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了加纳塞地对美元汇率序列中的结构性断裂，采用Bai-Perron检验和ICSS检验确认了均值和波动率的结构变化，并比较了ARIMA、Prophet和LSTM三种模型的预测性能。结果表明Prophet模型表现最佳，预测精度最高。
AI.research_question: 加纳塞地对美元汇率序列中是否存在结构性断裂？这些断裂如何影响不同模型（ARIMA、Prophet、LSTM）的预测准确性？
AI.motivation: 加纳塞地对美元汇率持续不稳定，影响通货膨胀、贸易、投资和货币政策。识别结构性断裂并评估其对预测模型的影响，有助于改善汇率预测和管理汇率风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性断裂理论（Bai-Perron多重结构断裂检验、ICSS波动率断裂检验）、时间序列预测理论（ARIMA、Prophet、LSTM）
AI.method: 使用Bai-Perron多重结构断裂检验和ICSS检验识别均值和波动率的结构性断裂；采用二元分割（binary segmentation）方法进行变点分析；对比ARIMA、Prophet和LSTM三种模型的预测性能，以MAE、MSE、RMSE作为评估指标。
AI.findings: （1）Bai-Perron和ICSS检验确认汇率序列在均值和波动率上均存在结构性变化；（2）变点分析与重大宏观经济冲击和货币政策变化相吻合；（3）Prophet模型表现最佳（MAE=1.80, MSE=3.73, RMSE=1.93），优于LSTM和ARIMA模型；（4）ARIMA模型预测表现相对较差。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调在汇率建模和预测中考虑结构性断裂的重要性，为汇率时间序列建模提供了实证证据，丰富了关于结构断裂对预测模型影响的学术讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和企业管理汇率不确定性和风险提供了有价值的洞察，有助于改进汇率预测策略和风险管理决策。

title: Biogas Development: Relevance in the Contemporary Palm Waste Management Processes in Cameroon
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Biogas Development: Relevance in the Contemporary Palm Waste Management Processes in Cameroon

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Accomplished and result-driven management professional with a strong drive, passion, and curiosity who seeks to contribute to the energy transition and address global challenges through research in environment, RE, climate actions, energy contemporary issues etc. The privilege of having a vast background in academic knowledge amplifies my ability to create and proposed answers to problems identified and also put out information on existing opportunities and challenges of different areas around the World especially Africa while contributing to finding solutions to the several problems that the World is faced with today.

detail.abstract: The study's main objective was to assess the relationship between biogas development and its relevance in contemporary palm waste management in Cameroon. It focuses on recycling palm oil mill effluent (POME) for production of biogas suitable to be adopted for electricity and or gas production both in urban and rural areas. The research explored secondary data and field observation. The waste mix in the palm oil production cycle stands at 80% as per (Egbe et al., 2023). According to (Tojo, 2019), despite the obvious benefits of oil palm production (OPP), the waste generated in the production cycle that includes wastewater called POME, release odour that cause hazards on the environment and climatic conditions. According to (Ladanai and Vinterbäck, 2010), biomass is considered to be the most reliable RE and fourth largest energy source to derive biofuels such as biodiesel, bio-oil, bioethanol, biobutanol, biochar, bio coal, biogas, biogazifier, biohydrogen, syngas, etc. Cameroon still faces lots of challenges in the implementation of these conversion techniques to sustainably manage related agricultural waste. Results of the study showed that, palm waste disposed on open landfills and water bodies is hazardous to the ecosystem. As per (Lam et al., 2021), several economies around the World depend largely on agricultural production in their development strategy. There is an urgent need for a sustainable approach to be adopted by developing countries like Cameroon to manage the enormous biomass, which is a feedstock for different RE conversion technologies, necessary to replace fossil fuels in the energy transition period. Also, as per the Cameroon Strategic Document for Employment Growth (DSCE), Cameroon's Vision 2035, aims to increase energy production and consumption per GDP unit by 27.7%, with the country's NDC specifying the commitment to produce at least 10% energy from biomass. UNIDO has assisted the government in this light by successfully designing and constructing a biogas power plant in the West Region that joints to these efforts and also contributes to mitigates GHG emissions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了喀麦隆棕榈油厂废水（POME）通过沼气生产实现可持续管理的可行性，旨在通过沼气技术将棕榈油废弃物转化为电能和燃气，以应对环境危害并支持国家能源转型目标。
AI.research_question: 沼气开发与喀麦隆当代棕榈废弃物管理之间的关联性及其可行性如何？
AI.motivation: 喀麦隆棕榈油生产产生大量废弃物（占生产周期的80%），其中POME废水释放恶臭，对环境与气候造成严重危害；同时喀麦隆面临可持续农业废弃物管理的巨大挑战，亟需开发可再生能源替代化石燃料。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物质作为可靠可再生能源和第四大能源来源的理论，以及沼气转化技术在废弃物管理和能源生产中的适用性框架。
AI.method: 采用二手数据（secondary data）收集与实地观察（field observation）相结合的研究方法。
AI.findings: 棕榈废弃物露天填埋和排入水体对生态系统具有危害性；喀麦隆在废弃物转化技术实施方面仍面临诸多挑战；但沼气发电厂建设（如UNIDO在西部大区协助建设的项目）已被证明是可行的实践路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将沼气开发与棕榈废弃物管理相结合，为发展中国家（尤其是喀麦隆）可持续生物质废弃物管理提供了理论支撑，丰富了可再生能源转化技术在发展中国家情境下的应用研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为喀麦隆实现Vision 2035中能源效率提升27.7%的目标和NDC中至少10%生物质能源生产的承诺提供了实践方案；展示沼气发电厂建设的可行案例，有助于缓解GHG排放并改善废弃物管理的环境危害。

title: Ensuring Digital Government Service Reliability: A Practice-based Case Study of Role-based Software Quality Assurance in a Provincial e-government Application
affiliations: and

detail.title: Ensuring Digital Government Service Reliability: A Practice-based Case Study of Role-based Software Quality Assurance in a Provincial e-government Application
detail.abstract: Local government agencies in Indonesia are increasingly dependent on internally developed digital tools to support administrative workflows, yet the Software Quality Assurance (SQA) practices underpinning these tools remain under-documented in the academic literature, particularly for rolebased, low-resource public-sector environments. This paper presents a practice-based case study of the SQA process applied to APTIKATOOLS, an internal web application used by the Aplikasi dan Informatika (APTIKA) division of the West Java Provincial Communication and Informatics Office (Diskominfo) to manage correspondence, task assignment, and work reporting. Drawing on a structured, ten-stage QA workflow, spanning actor and role identification, role-based access control (RBAC) mapping, test-case design, black-box functional testing, bug reporting, and retesting, the study documents how quality assurance was operationalized in a real government IT environment and evaluates this practice against established SQA, software testing, and RBAC frameworks. A SWOT-TOWS analysis is used to synthesize internal capabilities and external conditions into actionable strategy. The findings indicate that the process's principal strengths lie in its traceable documentation and role-differentiated test design, while its central weaknesses are the absence of automated testing, standardized quality metrics, and centralized bug tracking, limitations that mirror capacity constraints frequently observed in digitalizing public-sector organizations. The paper contributes an empirically grounded account of how SQA and RBAC principles translate into practice within a resource-constrained government setting, and offers concrete recommendations, regression test suites, quality metrics, centralized bug tracking, standardized role matrices, and phased test automation for strengthening quality assurance maturity in similar institutional contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对印度尼西亚西爪哇省政府通信与信息办公室（Diskominfo）APTIKA部门内部开发的应用APTIKATOOLS进行基于实践的案例研究，详细记录了从角色识别、RBAC映射、测试用例设计到黑盒功能测试、缺陷报告与回归测试的十阶段QA工作流程，并采用SWOT-TOWS分析将内部能力与外部条件整合为可操作策略，揭示了该流程在可追溯文档和角色差异化测试设计方面的优势，以及缺乏自动化测试、标准化质量指标和集中化缺陷跟踪等短板，为资源受限的公共部门环境中的SQA实践提供了实证参考。
AI.research_question: 在资源受限的基于角色的公共部门环境中，软件质量保证（SQA）实践是如何被具体操作化和实施的？这些实践与既有SQA、软件测试和RBAC框架的对照情况如何？
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚地方政府机构日益依赖内部开发的数字工具支持行政工作流程，但学术界对这些工具背后的SQA实践记录不足，特别是在基于角色的、资源有限的公共部门环境中，缺乏实证研究来揭示SQA和RBAC原则如何在实际中落地。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软件质量保证（SQA）框架、软件测试理论、基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）框架，以及SWOT-TOWS战略分析框架。
AI.method: 基于实践的案例研究方法，对APTIKATOOLS内部Web应用程序实施结构化的十阶段QA工作流程（包括角色识别、RBAC映射、测试用例设计、黑盒功能测试、缺陷报告与回归测试），并结合SWOT-TOWS分析进行策略综合评估。
AI.findings: 该QA流程的主要优势在于可追溯的文档记录和角色差异化测试设计；主要弱点在于缺乏自动化测试、标准化质量指标和集中化缺陷跟踪，这些限制反映了数字化公共部门组织中常见的能力约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 为SQA和RBAC原则在资源受限的政府环境中如何转化为实践提供了实证基础的案例描述，填补了公共部门数字工具SQA实践文献的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体建议：回归测试套件、质量指标、集中化缺陷跟踪、标准化角色矩阵和分阶段测试自动化，以帮助类似制度背景的机构提升质量保证成熟度。

title: Patent Delay and Innovation Dynamics in Brazil: Institutional Constraints, Strategic Behavior, and Policy Reform
affiliations: Pontifical Catholic University of Sao Paolo (PUCSP)

detail.title: Patent Delay and Innovation Dynamics in Brazil: Institutional Constraints, Strategic Behavior, and Policy Reform

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declared that this work was conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Given that the author is not native English speaker, this manuscript underwent an extensive review process. Specifically, Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools were utilized to ensure an accurate translation from Portuguese to English and to enhance general consistency, coherence and cohesion of the text. The authors acknowledge that this editorial assistance, while improving linguistic quality, may potentially result in the detection of AI-generated content by automated verification tools, such as Turnitin. This full disclosure is made in the interest of transparency regarding the manuscript's production process.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Pontifical Catholic University of São Paulo (PUC/SP) and Fundacentro as part of the author's regular academic and professional activities.

detail.abstract: The relationship between patent delay and innovation has been widely studied in advanced economies, yet its implications in emerging innovation systems remain underexplored. This article examines the Brazilian case, where prolonged patent examination delays have historically functioned as a structural constraint rather than a purely strategic instrument. Drawing on the literature on patent systems, innovation economics, and institutional theory, the study argues that excessive delays in patent publication and grant undermine knowledge diffusion, increase market uncertainty, and weaken incentives for technological investment. Using a comprehensive dataset of 874,680 patent applications from the Brazilian National Institute of Industrial Property (INPI), this study employs Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) and multiple linear regression to investigate the structural determinants of patent prosecution delays. The findings reveal that the number of applicants (R² = 22.18%) and the technological sector (R² = 20.32%) are the primary explanatory factors, while temporal filing cohort (0.64%) and technological complexity (0.01%) have negligible effects. Patents with six or more applicants exhibit an average delay of approximately 5,455 additional days compared to single-applicant filings, whereas the 2020+ cohort shows a significant reduction of 530 days—evidence of institutional improvements. Recent reforms—particularly the Backlog Combat Plan introduced in 2019 and international cooperation mechanisms such as the Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH)—suggest a transition toward a more efficient and strategically navigable system. The analysis highlights a shift from systemic delay toward hybrid dynamics in which firms increasingly incorporate timing into their innovation strategies. The article contributes to the literature by positioning institutional efficiency as a central determinant of innovation outcomes in developing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文以巴西为案例，研究专利审查延迟对创新的影响，使用87万多件INPI专利申请数据，通过方差分析和多元线性回归发现，申请人数量和科技领域是专利延迟的主要解释因素，而近期改革正在推动巴西从系统性延迟向混合动态转变。
AI.research_question: 在新兴创新体系中，专利审查延迟的结构性决定因素是什么？专利延迟如何影响创新产出？
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要关注发达经济体中专利延迟与创新的关系，而对新兴经济体（如巴西）中专利延迟的影响缺乏充分探讨。巴西长期存在的专利审查延迟构成了一种结构性约束，而非纯粹的战略性工具，需要系统研究其决定因素和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利制度理论、创新经济学、制度理论
AI.method: 使用巴西国家工业产权局（INPI）的874,680件专利申请综合数据集，采用方差分析（ANOVA）和多元线性回归分析专利审查延迟的结构性决定因素。
AI.findings: 申请人数量（R²=22.18%）和科技领域（R²=20.32%）是主要解释因素；时间申请队列（0.64%）和技术复杂性（0.01%）的影响可忽略。拥有6个及以上申请人的专利平均延迟比单一申请人多约5,455天；2020年以后队列显示延迟显著减少530天，表明制度有所改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度效率定位为发展中经济体创新结果的核心决定因素，丰富了专利系统、创新经济学和制度理论在新兴经济体的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体的专利制度改革提供实证依据，验证了2019年积压治理计划和专利审查高速公路（PPH）等国际合作机制的效果，有助于指导政策制定者优化专利审查流程。

title: Infinite-Horizon Consumption Ratcheting under Epstein-Zin Preferences
affiliations: Kyung Hee University - Department of Applied Mathematics

detail.title: Infinite-Horizon Consumption Ratcheting under Epstein-Zin Preferences
detail.abstract: We solve an infinite-horizon consumption-investment problem with nondecreasing consumption under Epstein-Zin stochastic differential utility. Dynamic programming yields a two-state singular-control Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman variational inequality. Under an explicit single-crossing condition, homogeneity reduces the problem to a nonlinear free-boundary ordinary differential equation for the wealth-consumption ratio, whose regular singular solution corresponds to the unstable orbit of a hyperbolic saddle. A unique transverse crossing identifies the consumption trigger. We construct the reflected optimal policy and verify its optimality using recursive-utility comparison and an exact transversality estimate. As the inverse elasticity of intertemporal substitution approaches relative risk aversion, preferences converge to the time-additive constant-relative-riskaversion case, and the solution converges to Dybvig's ratcheting benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在Epstein-Zin随机微分效用下、消费不可递减（棘轮约束）的无限期消费-投资问题。通过动态规划导出两状态奇异控制HJB变分不等式，在显式单交叉条件下利用齐次性将问题归结为非线性自由边界常微分方程，其正则奇异解对应双曲鞍的不稳定轨道。通过唯一横截穿越确定消费触发点，构造反射最优策略并验证最优性。当跨期替代弹性的倒数趋近相对风险厌恶系数时，偏好收敛至时间可加CRRA情形，解也收敛至Dybvig棘轮基准。
AI.research_question: 在Epstein-Zin随机微分效用下，如何求解具有消费不可递减约束（棘轮约束）的无限期消费-投资问题，并得到显式的最优策略和消费触发规则？
AI.motivation: 现实中消费者通常难以接受消费水平的下降（棘轮效应），而传统CRRA效用假设无法刻画消费者对不确定性的风险态度与跨期替代偏好的分离。Dybvig的棘轮模型仅适用于时间可加CRRA效用，需要将其推广至更灵活的Epstein-Zin递归效用框架下。
AI.theoretical_framework: Epstein-Zin随机微分效用（递归效用）、奇异控制HJB变分不等式、齐次性约化、自由边界ODE、双曲鞍点与横截穿越理论、Dybvig棘轮模型
AI.method: 动态规划方法导出两状态奇异控制HJB变分不等式；利用齐次性将问题约化为非线性自由边界常微分方程；通过正则奇异解对应双曲鞍不稳定轨道、唯一横截穿越识别消费触发点；构造反射最优策略并利用递归效用比较和精确横截性估计验证最优性；通过极限分析建立与Dybvig基准的收敛关系。
AI.findings: （1）在显式单交叉条件下，消费触发由横截穿越唯一确定；（2）构造了反射最优策略并严格验证了其最优性；（3）当逆跨期替代弹性趋近相对风险厌恶系数时，Epstein-Zin偏好退化为时间可加CRRA情形，解收敛至Dybvig棘轮基准，建立了两种效用框架下棘轮消费问题的统一视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Dybvig的棘轮消费基准从时间可加CRRA效用推广到Epstein-Zin递归效用框架，分离了风险厌恶与跨期替代偏好的影响；建立了奇异控制HJB变分不等式与自由边界ODE之间的严格数学联系；通过横截穿越方法给出了消费触发点的唯一性刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: 为具有消费棘轮约束的投资者提供了显式的最优消费-投资策略，帮助理解在消费不可下降约束下投资者应如何调整储蓄与资产配置；为财富管理中的消费规划提供了理论指导。

title: The Riemann Ξ-Function as a Characteristic Function
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Riemann Ξ-Function as a Characteristic Function

keywords: Linnik Provide your feedback on BizChat

detail.abstract:
We survey the probabilistic reformulations of the Riemann Hypothesis (RH) that are organised around the Riemann Ξ-function, and we assess what part of this circle of ideas is legitimately attributable to Yu. V. Linnik. The narrow answer is negative: there is no Linnik theorem about Ξ; the reality-of-zeros programme runs Pólya → Turán → de Bruijn → Newman → Rodgers-Tao. The broad answer is affirmative and, we argue, more useful. Linnik's two legacies-(i) the unconditional substitutes for RH and GRH (the large sieve, log-free zero-density estimates, the Deuring-Heilbronn repulsion phenomenon, Linnik's identity, the dispersion method), and (ii) the theory of entire characteristic functions, ridge functions, and the Linnik-Ostrovskii arithmetic of probability laws-together supply exactly the language in which the modern van Dantzig and Laguerre-Pólya reformulations of RH are stated. 

     We then push the probabilistic reading one step further. Writing X Ξ for the symmetric random variable with characteristic function φ(t) = Ξ(t)/Ξ(0), we record two structural facts. First, X Ξ is never infinitely divisible, because φ has zeros; the infinite-divisibility question therefore belongs not to X Ξ but to its van Dantzig partner Y Ξ , whose characteristic function is Ξ(0)/Ξ(it). Second-and this is the organising observation of the paper-RH is equivalent to the statement that Y Ξ is an infinite convolution of symmetric Laplace laws with scales 1/γ, γ running over the positive ordinates of the zeta zeros. Equivalently, Y Ξ lies in the Thorin class T (R) of extended generalized gamma convolutions with Thorin measure equal to the zero-counting measure, U = γ>0 δ γ. The Lévy density of Y Ξ is |x|-1 γ>0 e-γ|x| , whose evaluation by the Weil explicit formula converts the Thorin measure into a sum over primes. We give a cumulant-alternation criterion and verify it numerically through order twenty. 

     The converse question-whether positive-definiteness of the partner's candidate characteristic function is by itself equivalent to RH-we settle partially. Writing ψ as a signed mixture of Laplace laws with weights summing to one, we prove via Landau's theorem for Laplace transforms of nonnegative functions that positive-definiteness forces the zeros of least ordinate onto the critical line, and no more; exact high-precision computation of the mixture density shows that displacing any higher zero off the line, even to the edge of the critical strip, leaves the density nonnegative. The van Dantzig criterion is therefore a consequence of RH worth exploiting rather than a route to proving it. Applying a Lévy-to-Thorin lemma at the centre α = 1 2 , where the drift vanishes because ξ ′ (1 2) = 0, identifies the partner as a Gaussian variance mixture √ 2H Z and separates two hypotheses that are easily conflated: the existence of H pins only the lowest zero, whereas H being a generalized gamma convolution is equivalent to RH. The arithmetic input is exactly Λ ≥ 0, carried by a sine-squared transform.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了围绕Riemann Ξ函数的Riemann猜想（RH）的概率论重述，评估了Linnik在此思想脉络中的贡献，并提出新的结构发现：RH等价于某个对称随机变量Y_Ξ是Thorin类中的广义Gamma卷积（其Thorin测度即零点计数测度）。文章进一步验证了累积量交替准则，并通过Landau定理部分解决了正定性的逆向问题，指出van Dantzig准则只是RH的推论而非证明途径。
AI.research_question: （1）在RH的概率论重述中，Linnik的贡献应如何准确界定？（2）RH是否可以等价地表述为Y_Ξ（van Dantzig伙伴随机变量）属于Thorin类T(R)？（3）伙伴特征函数的正定性本身是否足以推出RH？
AI.motivation: Riemann猜想有多种等价表述，其中围绕Ξ函数的概率论重述（van Dantzig和Laguerre-Pólya类）是活跃研究方向。作者希望：一是厘清Linnik在此领域的真实贡献（学术史问题）；二是进一步推进概率论解读，将RH转化为明确的无限可分解性/广义Gamma卷积问题；三是检验van Dantzig准则是否为证明RH的可行路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率论框架：特征函数、无限可分分布、Thorin类T(R)（广义Gamma卷积）、Lévy-Khintchine表示、van Dantzig配对、Laguerre-Pólya类；解析数论框架：Riemann Ξ函数、Weil显式公式、Landau定理、大筛法、对数自由零点密度估计、Deuring-Heilbronn排斥现象、Linnik恒等式、散布方法、整特征函数与ridge函数理论、Linnik-Ostrovskii概率律算术。
AI.method: （1）学术史梳理：追踪RH概率论重述的谱系（Pólya → Turán → de Bruijn → Newman → Rodgers-Tao），评估Linnik的真实贡献；（2）构造性概率分析：定义对称随机变量X_Ξ（特征函数φ(t)=Ξ(t)/Ξ(0)）及其van Dantzig伙伴Y_Ξ（特征函数Ξ(0)/Ξ(it)），证明RH等价于Y_Ξ属于Thorin类；（3）数值验证：通过高阶累积量交替准则验证到阶数20；（4）逆向问题分析：利用Landau定理（关于非负函数Laplace变换）证明正定性只能迫使最低阶零点在临界线上，无法推出全部零点在临界线上；（5）Lévy-to-Thorin引理：在中心α=1/2处将伙伴识别为高斯方差混合√(2H)Z，区分两个假设。
AI.findings: （1）狭义的答案是：不存在Linnik关于Ξ的定理，零点实性程序的主线是Pólya→Turán→de Bruijn→Newman→Rodgers-Tao；但广义上Linnik的两大遗产（无条件替代RH/GRH的工具箱，以及整特征函数、ridge函数和Linnik-Ostrovskii概率律算术）正好提供了现代RH概率论重述所需的语言。（2）X_Ξ永远不是无限可分的（因其特征函数有零点），无限可分性问题属于其van Dantzig伙伴Y_Ξ。（3）RH等价于Y_Ξ是尺度为1/γ的对称Laplace律的无限卷积（γ遍历zeta零点正纵坐标），即Y_Ξ属于Thorin类T(R)，Thorin测度等于零点计数测度。Lévy密度为|x|^{-1}Σ_{γ>0}e^{-γ|x|}，通过Weil显式公式可将Thorin测度转化为素数求和。（4）给出了累积量交替准则并数值验证到20阶。（5）正定性只能迫使最小纵坐标的零点在临界线上，不能推出更多；将任何更高零点移离临界线（甚至移到临界带的边缘），密度仍然非负。因此van Dantzig准则只是RH的推论而非证明途径。（6）在α=1/2处，高斯方差混合表示√(2H)Z区分了两种易混淆的假设：H的存在只能钉住最低零点，而H是广义Gamma卷积等价于RH。算术输入恰好是Λ≥0（通过正弦平方变换承载）。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）对Linnik在RH概率论重述中的贡献进行了首�次的系统性学术史评估，区分了狭义与广义贡献；（2）建立了RH与Thorin类（广义Gamma卷积）之间的明确等价关系，将RH转化为一个纯概率论的结构问题；（3）证明了van Dantzig准则的局限性：正定性最多只能推出最低零点在临界线上，不能作为证明RH的充分条件；（4）通过Lévy-to-Thorin引理在高斯方差混合框架下区分了两个易混淆的假设，厘清了概念边界。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了累积量交替准则作为RH的数值检验工具（验证到20阶）；（2）给出了高精度数值计算混合密度的方法，可精确检测零点位移对密度非负性的影响；（3）为后续研究提供了明确的研究路线：若要在概率论框架下推进RH的证明，需要超越正定性准则，探求更强的结构条件。

title: Thorin Quantisation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Thorin Quantisation
detail.abstract: The reciprocal of a normalised Laguerre-Pólya entire function is the Laplace transform of a generalised gamma convolution (GGC) whose Thorin measure is supported on the squared zeros. We show that for entire functions of genus zero the converse holds in a strong form: if the associated clock is a GGC at all, its Thorin measure is automatically a counting measure with unit atoms. Quantisation is therefore not an extra hypothesis but a consequence, and the entire content of the Riemann Hypothesis, read through the van Dantzig-Wald dictionary, sits in the single step from infinite divisibility to the Thorin class. We make this precise in three ways. First, we identify the GGC locus inside the class of van Dantzig solutions constructed by Konstantopoulos, Patie and Sarkar from Laplace exponents of spectrally negative Lévy processes: their hitting-time clocks are always selfdecomposable, and are GGC exactly when the associated entire function has only real zeros; the Mittag-Leffler instances give explicit self-decomposable hitting times that are not GGC. Second, we show that no Lévy-Khintchine representation of log ξ(α + s) with a non-negative Lévy measure can be established at α = 1 2 without already assuming the absence of zeros to the right of α, and we correct a spurious Thorin atom that arises when ξ is factored through the pole of ζ. Third, working from the shifted basepoint s = 3 2 , we prove that RH is equivalent to σ → ξ(3 2)/ξ(1 2 + √ 1 + σ) being the Laplace transform of a GGC, equivalently to its hyperbolic complete monotonicity, and we convert this into a determinantal criterion: RH holds if and only if the Hankel matrices of the power sums c n = ρ [(3 2-ρ)(ρ + 1 2)]-(n+1) , summed over zero pairs, are positive semidefinite. The criterion is unconditionally computable from the Taylor coefficients of ξ at 3 2 ; we verify it numerically through order five and recover γ 1 = 14.1347. .. from the coefficient ratios.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了规范化Laguerre-Pólya整函数的倒数的拉普拉斯变换与广义伽马卷积（GGC）之间的关系，证明了零级整函数的"量子化"性质是自动成立的而非额外假设。论文将黎曼猜想的全部内容精确定位到从无限可分性到Thorin类的单一步骤中，并通过三种方式加以精确化：识别GGC轨迹、修正伪Thorin原子、以及建立RH的等价行列式判据。
AI.research_question: 零级Laguerre-Pólya整函数的倒数作为广义伽马卷积（GGC）的拉普拉斯变换时，其Thorin测度是否自动具有单位原子的计数测度形式？以及如何通过van Dantzig-Wald词典将黎曼猜想精确定位并转化为可计算的行列式判据？
AI.motivation: 此前文献中常将"量子化"（即Thorin测度为带单位原子的计数测度）作为额外假设加入，但作者证明这是零级整函数的自动结论。更重要的是，通过这一框架可以将黎曼猜想的全部内容压缩到从无限可分到Thorin类的单一步骤中，并给出等价的可数值验证的判据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于以下理论框架：Laguerre-Pólya整函数理论、广义伽马卷积（GGC）与Thorin测度理论、van Dantzig-Wald词典（将Lévy过程与黎曼ζ函数联系）、自分解（selfdecomposable）分布理论、Lévy-Khintchine表示、以及Hankel矩阵与完全单调性理论。
AI.method: 论文采用三种方法：(1) 分析Konstantopoulos-Patie-Sarkar构造的van Dantzig解类，证明其hitting-time clock的自分解性质及GGC条件（等价于整函数只有实零点）；(2) 分析log ξ(α+s)在α=1/2处Lévy-Khintchine表示的不可能性，并修正由ζ极点因式分解产生的伪Thorin原子；(3) 从s=3/2基点出发，将RH等价转化为GGC拉普拉斯变换及双曲完全单调性，并进一步转化为Hankel矩阵正半定性的行列式判据，用Taylor系数进行数值验证至五阶。
AI.findings: (1) 零级整函数的倒数是GGC时，其Thorin测度自动为带单位原子的计数测度（量子化是结论而非假设）；(2) Konstantopoulos-Patie-Sarkar构造的hitting-time clock总是自分解的，且为GGC当且仅当关联整函数只有实零点，Mittag-Leffler实例给出自分解但非GGC的反例；(3) 在α=1/2处无法在不预先假设零点位置的情况下建立非负Lévy测度的Lévy-Khintchine表示；(4) RH等价于σ→ξ(3/2)/ξ(1/2+√(1+σ))为GGC的拉普拉斯变换，等价于其双曲完全单调性，也等价于Hankel矩阵（由零点幂和c_n构成）的正半定性；(5) 数值验证至五阶，成功恢复γ₁=14.1347。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 证明了零级整函数情形下GGC的Thorin测度自动量子化，消除了额外的假设需求；(2) 将RH的核心内容精确定位为"从无限可分性到Thorin类"的单一步骤，深化了van Dantzig-Wald词典这一理论联系；(3) 修正了此前文献中因ζ极点因式分解导致的伪Thorin原子问题；(4) 建立了RH与Hankel矩阵正半定性之间的严格等价，提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 给出了RH的无条件可计算的双曲完全单调性判据，可从ξ在3/2处的Taylor系数直接计算；(2) 将RH转化为Hankel矩阵正半定性的数值验证问题，提供了实际操作路径；(3) 数值验证至五阶并成功恢复第一个非平凡零点γ₁=14.1347，展示了判据的可行性和有效性。

title: Factor Investing with Climate: Engineer a "Climate-Resilient" Factor Portfolio for JSE
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Factor Investing with Climate: Engineer a "Climate-Resilient" Factor Portfolio for JSE

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive data. Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The research was conducted independently as part of the MSc Financial Engineering program at WorldQuant University.

detail.abstract:
This paper investigates the integration of climate transition risk into quantitative factor investing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE). We engineer a novel "Climate-Resilient" long-short factor portfolio by sorting listed firms based on their implied climate sensitivity (λ), derived from carbon emission intensities, asset life cycle exposures, and regulatory transition costs. The strategy takes a long position in low-λ (climate-resilient) firms and a short position in high-λ (transition-vulnerable) firms. Backtesting results over the 2018-2026 period demonstrate an enhanced Sharpe ratio, controlled portfolio turnover, and robust execution capacity within the liquidity constraints of emerging African markets. 

     The motivation for this study stems from two converging trends. First, South Africa's energy matrix remains heavily dependent on coal, exposing listed firms to regulatory, technological, and reputational transition shocks. Second, global institutional capital is increasingly reallocating toward climate-aware mandates, creating systematic mispricing for firms that fail to adapt. By quantifying transition risk at the firm level and embedding it into a tradable factor, this paper provides an implementable framework for investors seeking to hedge climate exposure while capturing alpha. 

     Our empirical findings suggest that climate sensitivity is a priced risk factor on the JSE. The long-short portfolio generates 3.7% annual excess return over the benchmark with 1.7% lower volatility. Importantly, the strategy maintains semi-annual turnover below 45% and estimated capacity above ZAR 4.5 billion, indicating that climate-resilient investing is not only academically interesting but also practically viable in an emerging market context.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了约翰内斯堡证券交易所（JSE）上将气候转型风险纳入量化因子投资的框架。作者基于碳排放强度、资产生命周期暴露和监管转型成本构建了"气候韧性"多空因子组合，做多低碳敏感度（气候韧性）企业、做空高碳敏感度（转型脆弱）企业。2018-2026年回测结果显示该策略在夏普比率、换手率和流动性容量方面均表现优异，表明气候韧性投资在新兴市场具有实践可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何将气候转型风险系统性地嵌入量化因子投资框架，并在新兴市场（南非JSE）中构建可交易的气候韧性投资策略？
AI.motivation: 两大趋势驱动：第一，南非能源结构高度依赖煤炭，上市公司面临监管、技术和声誉层面的转型冲击；第二，全球机构资本日益转向气候意识投资，导致未能适应转型的企业出现系统性错误定价。作者旨在量化企业层面的转型风险并将其嵌入可交易因子，为投资者提供对冲气候风险的同时获取alpha的可行框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候转型风险定价理论；因子投资理论；多空组合构建与风险溢价理论
AI.method: 构建"气候敏感性"指标（λ），综合碳排放强度、资产生命周期暴露和监管转型成本三个维度对上市公司进行排序；构建低λ（气候韧性）做多—高λ（转型脆弱）做空的多空因子组合；在2018-2026年期间对JSE进行回测，评估夏普比率、换手率和流动性容量等指标。
AI.findings: 气候敏感性是JSE上的定价风险因子。多空组合相对基准产生3.7%的年化超额收益，波动率降低1.7%；半年度换手率保持在45%以下，估计策略容量超过45亿兰特，表明策略在流动性约束下具有可执行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候转型风险从理论概念转化为可量化的企业层面因子指标（λ），并验证其在新兴市场（而非仅发达市场）中作为定价风险因子的有效性，拓展了气候金融与因子投资交叉领域的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供了在新兴市场（南非）中实施气候韧性投资的可行框架，包括具体的因子构建方法、策略容量评估和流动性约束考量，为对冲气候转型风险同时获取超额收益提供了可操作的实践指南。

title:
The Formula of Capital:
Ontology and Theoretical Unification of Economics

detail.title:
The Formula of Capital:
Ontology and Theoretical Unification of Economics
detail.abstract:
This article proposes a labor value theory articulated through one unified equality. This equality is neither a technical model nor an accounting identity. It is an ontology. It provides the structure to understand why value exists, why it is destroyed, accumulated, enters into crisis, inflated, validated, or denied. 
The formula reveals the dialectical origin of macroeconomic phenomena through the common variables (omega and pi), since the same social structure organizes both production and realization, making it possible to distinguish between the phenomenon and its dual cause. This turns the formula into a unique tool—an ontological framework for comprehending the social totality of capitalism, with which dynamic simulations, econometric dashboards, and new theoretical explorations can be developed. 
The equality thus becomes a bridge between the ontology of labor value and contemporary research practice. This preprint highlights the formula as a concise entry point, making theoretical unification accessible to a broader academic audience and ensuring proper citation of the complete work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过单一统一等式阐述的劳动价值理论。该等式既非技术模型也非会计恒等式，而是一种本体论框架，用以理解价值为何存在、被破坏、积累、陷入危机、膨胀、被验证或被否定。该等式通过共同变量（ω和π）揭示了宏观经济现象的辩证起源，将劳动价值本体论与当代研究实践连接起来。
AI.research_question: 如何通过一个统一的等式构建劳动价值理论的本体论框架，以解释资本主义社会总体中的价值现象及其辩证起源？
AI.motivation: 现有劳动价值理论缺乏一个统一的本体论框架，无法同时解释价值的存在、破坏、积累、危机、膨胀、验证与被否定等多元现象。作者旨在提供一个超越技术模型和会计恒等式的本体论等式，作为理解资本主义社会整体性的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动价值理论（Labor Value Theory）；马克思主义政治经济学；辩证唯物主义；社会本体论
AI.method: 理论建构/概念分析——提出统一的等式作为本体论框架，通过共同变量（ω和π）说明生产与实现由同一社会结构组织，区分现象与其双重原因，并支持动态模拟、计量经济学面板和理论探索。
AI.findings: 该等式揭示了宏观经济现象的辩证起源（通过共同变量ω和π），能够区分现象与其双重原因，成为连接劳动价值本体论与当代研究实践（动态模拟、计量经济学仪表板、新理论探索）的桥梁。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的本体论等式，将劳动价值理论从技术模型和会计恒等式中解放出来，提供理解资本主义社会总体性的本体论框架，并建立了经典马克思主义理论（劳动价值论）与当代研究实践之间的理论桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 该等式可支持动态模拟、计量经济学仪表板开发等具体研究应用，为学术研究者提供了简洁的理论统一入口，方便更广泛学术群体的理解与引用。

title: Beyond Tariff Preferences: Rules of Origin and the Legal Architecture of African Economic Integration under the AfCFTA
affiliations: Legal researcher

detail.title: Beyond Tariff Preferences: Rules of Origin and the Legal Architecture of African Economic Integration under the AfCFTA
detail.abstract:
The African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) is intended to boost trade among African countries and to improve economic integration throughout the continent.One of the key ways in which it aims to do this is by means ofpreferential tariff treatment for products exchanged between State Parties. 


The benefits of these preferences are dependent on the ability to establsh whether a product is eligible as originating in the AfCFTA. This article examines why these rules are important to the operation of the AfCFTA preferential regime. It argues that their role is not limited to determining which goods qualify for preferential treatment. They also protect the value of the preferences by preventing goods originating outside Africa from obtaining them through trade deflection. At the same time, rules of origin can influence where businesses source materials and organise production, particularly through continental cumulation, and can therefore contribute to the development of African value chains. The article argues that the effectiveness of the AfCFTA rules of origin depends on maintaining a workable balance between these two functions. Rules that are too weak may undermine the preferential regime, while rules that are too restrictive or costly to comply with may discourage African producers from using the preferences available to them. The article therefore considers the rules of origin not simply as technical customs requirements, but as an important part of the legal framework through which the AfCFTA seeks to promote greater economic integration and value addition within Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）原产地规则的重要性，认为其不仅决定商品是否符合优惠待遇资格，还通过防止贸易转离来保护优惠的价值，同时通过大陆累积机制影响企业采购和生产布局，促进非洲价值链发展。文章主张原产地规则的有效性取决于在保护优惠制度与降低合规成本之间维持可行平衡。
AI.research_question: 为什么原产地规则对非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）优惠制度的运作至关重要？原产地规则如何在保护优惠制度与促进非洲区域价值链发展之间取得平衡？
AI.motivation: 非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）旨在通过优惠关税待遇促进非洲国家间贸易和经济一体化，但优惠待遇的落实取决于能否确定产品是否符合原产地资格。理解原产地规则在AfCFTA中的作用对于该优惠制度的有效运作至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 原产地规则理论、区域贸易协定的优惠制度理论、贸易转离（trade deflection）理论、区域价值链理论
AI.method: 法律规范性分析（doctrinal legal analysis），通过对AfCFTA原产地规则的功能进行分析论证
AI.findings: 原产地规则在AfCFTA中有双重功能：一是决定哪些商品有资格获得优惠待遇并防止非非洲原产商品通过贸易转离获取优惠；二是通过大陆累积机制影响企业采购决策和生产组织，进而促进非洲价值链的发展。原产地规则的有效性取决于在这两个功能之间维持可行平衡——过于宽松会破坏优惠制度，过于严格则可能阻碍非洲生产者利用优惠。
AI.theory_contributions: 将原产地规则从单纯的技术性海关要求重新定位为AfCFTA促进非洲经济一体化和增值的重要法律框架组成部分，提出原产地规则需要在保护功能和促进功能之间取得平衡的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AfCFTA原产地规则的制定和实施提供政策建议，帮助政策制定者理解原产地规则如何影响非洲生产者的实际选择和区域价值链的发展。

title: Europe’s Climate Ambition Under Scrutiny: Evidence from Deep Learning Emission Projections
affiliations: Polytechnic University of Milan, RFF-CMCC European Institute on Economics and the Environment, RFF-CMCC European Institute on Economics and the Environment and Polytechnic University of Milan

detail.title: Europe’s Climate Ambition Under Scrutiny: Evidence from Deep Learning Emission Projections
detail.abstract: The European Union has committed to reducing greenhouse gas emissions 55\% below 1990 levels by 2030, but whether current trends are compatible with this ambition remains uncertain. We apply deep learning to high-resolution socioeconomic and sectoral data across EU27 member states till 2023 to project sectoral CO$_2$ trajectories under current trends, extrapolating observed sectoral momentum without assuming changes in the pace or effectiveness of the policy environment beyond what is already reflected in historical data. We project that EU27 emissions will exceed the 2030 target by 35\% (620 Mt CO$_2$ shortfall), with only a small minority of countries on trajectories consistent with the bloc's commitments. While the Power sector achieves target-consistent reductions driven by the renewable transition, Mobility shows minimal progress and accounts for over a third of total emissions by 2030, reflecting a structural inertia across member states rather than geographically concentrated lag. Our findings indicate that substantial additional intervention is required to close Europe's ambition-implementation gap, and call for establishing up-to-date energy information in Europe.

AI.tldr: 本文运用深度学习分析欧盟27国至2023年的高分辨率社会经济与部门数据，预测各部门CO₂排放轨迹。结果显示欧盟27国将超出2030年减排目标35%（缺口620 Mt CO₂），仅少数国家有望达标。电力部门在可再生能源转型推动下有望实现目标一致减排，但交通部门进展甚微且到2030年将占总排放三分之一以上，反映各成员国普遍存在结构性惯性。研究指出需要大量额外干预以弥合欧盟的雄心-实施差距，并呼吁建立最新的欧洲能源信息体系。
AI.research_question: 在当前趋势下，欧盟27国的各部门CO₂排放轨迹是否与2030年减排55%的目标兼容？哪些部门和国家存在最大的减排缺口？
AI.motivation: 欧盟承诺到2030年将温室气体排放较1990年水平减少55%，但当前趋势是否与这一雄心相符仍不确定。现有研究缺乏对最新数据（至2023年）下各部门排放轨迹的高分辨率预测，亟需评估欧盟的雄心-实施差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的排放轨迹预测框架，利用高分辨率社会经济和部门数据外推现有趋势，不假设政策环境变化超出历史数据已反映的范围。
AI.method: 对欧盟27国至2023年的高分辨率社会经济和部门数据应用深度学习模型，预测当前趋势下的各部门CO₂排放轨迹。
AI.findings: （1）欧盟27国排放将超出2030年目标35%，缺口达620 Mt CO₂；（2）仅少数国家处于与欧盟承诺一致的轨迹上；（3）电力部门在可再生能源转型推动下可实现目标一致减排；（4）交通部门进展甚微，到2030年将占总排放的三分之一以上，且这种落后是各成员国普遍存在的结构性惯性，而非地理集中性滞后。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过深度学习方法实现跨部门、跨国的高分辨率排放轨迹预测，揭示了交通部门的结构性惯性特征，为理解减排行动的实施差距提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供2030年减排目标的达标差距量化评估（620 Mt CO₂缺口），明确电力部门为亮点、交通部门为关键瓶颈的政策干预优先级，并呼吁建立最新的欧洲能源信息体系以支持循证决策。

title: The Third Source: Human Time as a Biophysical Resource, Entropic Rent, and the Thermodynamics of the Information Economy

detail.title: The Third Source: Human Time as a Biophysical Resource, Entropic Rent, and the Thermodynamics of the Information Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Biophysical economics has framed the limits to growth in terms of two low-entropy sources: the terrestrial mineral stock and the solar flow. This paper argues for a third, analytically distinct source: human time and builds the accounting it requires. Extending Georgescu-Roegen's flow-fund model, we specify the time-fund as a hybrid the original taxonomy lacks: a fund whose non-storable services are continuously reproduced through low-entropy throughput, yet which dissipates at a fixed rate whether used or not. We define entropic rent (R) as the exergy appropriated through human hours net of the reproduction cost of those hours, and time capitalization (κ) as the exergy mobilized per appropriated hour. Applied to the information and AI economy, the framework predicts that dematerialization relocates dissipation rather than removing it, and that a stalling κ is compensated by an expanding claim on unwaged hours. A pilot implementation for the United States, 1900-2024, carries the accounting from statement to measurement. Measured on waged hours, useful work per hour plateaus after 1973; measured on all appropriated hours, the denominator the framework specifies, it falls by 38 per cent, while the appropriated share of the time-fund (α) rises from 0.33 to 0.49an increase located entirely outside the wage relation. The unwaged margin is calibrated rather than measured, and the boundary between reproduction and appropriation moves R three times more than every measurement term combined. Four propositions state the framework in refutable form.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人类时间"是除矿物储量和太阳流之外的第三个低熵来源，通过扩展Georgescu-Roegen的流量-基金模型，构建了"时间基金"这一混合范畴，并定义了熵租金（R）和时间资本化（κ）两个核心概念。通过对美国1900-2024年的试点核算，发现以所有被占用的时间衡量，每小时有用功下降38%，而时间基金中被占用的份额从0.33升至0.49，且增长完全发生在工资关系之外。
AI.research_question: 人类时间能否作为独立于矿物储量和太阳流的第三类低熵来源被纳入生物物理经济学的增长极限分析框架？如何构建其核算体系？
AI.motivation: 传统生物物理经济学仅将增长极限归因于两个低熵来源（矿物储量与太阳流），忽略了人类时间这一在信息与AI经济中愈发关键的低熵来源。特别是去物质化趋势使得能源和物质消耗看似下降，但人类时间的耗散可能被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Georgescu-Roegen的流量-基金模型（flow-fund model）；时间基金作为原始分类中缺失的混合范畴——其非可储存服务通过低熵通量持续再生产，但无论使用与否都以固定速率耗散；熵租金（R）与时间资本化（κ）的定义框架。
AI.method: 理论模型构建（扩展flow-fund模型的类属学方法）+ 美国1900-2024年的试点核算（pilot implementation），区分工资时间与所有被占用时间两种口径，并对无工资边际进行校准。
AI.findings: （1）以工资时间衡量，每小时有用功在1973年后趋于平稳；（2）以框架规定的所有被占用时间衡量，每小时有用功下降38%；（3）时间基金中被占用份额α从0.33升至0.49，且增长完全发生在工资关系之外；（4）去物质化只是转移耗散而非消除耗散；（5）κ停滞由对无工资时间的扩张性占用所补偿。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出时间基金作为flow-fund模型原始分类缺失的第三类混合范畴，补全了生物物理经济学的类属学框架；（2）在理论上区分时间作为基金与作为通量的双重属性；（3）以四个可证伪命题形式正式陈述框架，使理论可检验。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了将信息与AI经济的去物质化叙事纳入物理核算的可操作指标（R和κ）；（2）揭示了增长核算中工资外时间（如家务、平台劳动等无工资劳动）被系统性忽略的问题；（3）为美国1900-2024年的长期时间-能源核算提供了试点数据。

title: Past Exposure, Future Innovation: CEO Board Experience and AI Innovation
affiliations: University of Southampton, University of Southampton, University of Southampton and University of Southampton

detail.title: Past Exposure, Future Innovation: CEO Board Experience and AI Innovation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Why do otherwise similar firms differ in their ability to convert technological opportunities into innovation? This paper studies whether one explanation lies in CEO prior exposure to innovation at other firms where they previously served on boards. Linking BoardEx employment histories to USPTO AI patents, we construct grant-based measures of CEO external AI innovation exposure. Firms led by CEO with greater external AI innovation exposure subsequently produce more AI Innovation, robust to firm, CEO and industry-year controls, and the relation is specific to AI rather than general patenting. Event studies around CEO turnover, comparing firms with similar pre-turnover innovation potential, show that the arrival of exposed CEO is followed by increases in both AI Innovation Filings and AI Innovation, with no evidence of pre-existing filing trends. The effect is stronger in firms with greater absorptive capacity, and exposed insider and outsider CEO transitions have similar effects. Exposed CEO are also associated with the reallocation of AI inventors to the firm, including from firms on whose boards they previously served, and give rise to first-time AI inventors at the firm. The findings show that technology-specific CEO exposure is a form of managerial human capital that helps firms transform frontier technological opportunities into realized innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了CEO的外部AI创新暴露（即CEO在其他公司董事会任职时接触到的AI创新经验）如何影响其所在企业的AI创新产出。研究发现，拥有更高外部AI创新暴露的CEO所领导的企业会产生更多的AI创新，这种效应通过CEO更替事件研究得到验证，且在吸收能力更强的企业中更为显著。暴露型CEO还会吸引AI发明者（包括来自其曾任董事会公司的发明者）加入企业，并催生企业首批AI发明者。
AI.research_question: 为什么看似相似的企业在将技术机会转化为创新成果的能力上存在差异？CEO此前在其他公司董事会任职时积累的创新暴露是否是一个重要解释因素？
AI.motivation: 企业间创新能力的差异是管理学和组织理论的经典难题，但已有研究较少关注CEO个人层面的外部经历（尤其是技术特异的董事会经历）如何塑造企业的技术创新能力。本文试图填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于管理人力资本理论，认为CEO的技术特异性外部暴露是一种特定于技术领域的管理人力资本形式，能够帮助企业将前沿技术机会转化为实际创新产出。
AI.method: 将BoardEx高管就业历史与美国专利商标局（USPTO）AI专利数据相链接，构建基于授权专利的CEO外部AI创新暴露指标；采用面板回归（控制企业、CEO和行业-年份固定效应）及CEO更替事件研究法进行因果识别。
AI.findings: （1）CEO外部AI创新暴露与企业后续AI创新产出正相关，且该关系具有AI技术特异性而非一般专利效应；（2）CEO更替事件研究表明，暴露型CEO的到来显著增加AI创新提交和授权，且无预存趋势；（3）效应在吸收能力更强的企业中更显著；（4）内部与外部继任的暴露型CEO效应相似；（5）暴露型CEO促进AI发明者向企业流动（包括来自其曾任董事会公司），并催生企业首批AI发明者。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"技术特异性CEO暴露"作为管理人力资本的新维度，将CEO个人经历与企业技术创新的关系从一般性管理能力拓展到技术领域特定的人力资本；揭示了CEO外部董事会经历的知识转移通道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业CEO选聘提供参考：在AI等前沿技术领域的创新竞争中，企业可考虑招募具有相关技术领域外部暴露的CEO；也为董事会治理和人才战略提供实践启示。

title: Climate Policy and Gender Inequality
affiliations: ESSCA School of Management

detail.title: Climate Policy and Gender Inequality
detail.abstract: Empirical evidence suggests that women, on average, are employed in lesscarbon-intensive sectors compared to men and exhibit stronger support forclimate action. This paper leverages this heterogeneity to study thedistributive effects of climate policy between men and women. The analysesrely on numerical experiments within an Environmental Dynamic StochasticGeneral Equilibrium (E-DSGE) model in which men and women differ in theirpreferences over carbon-intensive goods and in their comparative advantageacross sectors. Calibrating the model to the French economy, we find thatclimate policies, such as a carbon tax or a subsidy for the labor costs ofgreen firms, reduce the male-to-female income ratio---i.e., theyreduce gender-indexed income inequality. These findings suggest apotential "double dividend'' from green policies: simultaneous reductions incarbon emissions and in gender income inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文利用男性和女性在碳密集型部门就业及气候政策偏好上的异质性，通过环境动态随机一般均衡（E-DSGE）模型的数值实验，以法国经济为校准对象，发现碳税或绿色企业劳动成本补贴等气候政策能够降低男性对女性的收入比，从而同时减少碳排放与性别收入不平等，实现"双重红利"。
AI.research_question: 气候政策在男性和女性之间具有怎样的分配效应？气候政策能否同时减少碳排放和性别收入不平等？
AI.motivation: 经验证据表明女性平均就业于碳密集度较低的部门，且对气候行动支持度更高，但气候政策对性别维度的分配效应尚未被系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境动态随机一般均衡（E-DSGE）模型，模型中男性和女性在碳密集型商品偏好及跨部门比较优势上存在差异。
AI.method: 构建E-DSGE模型进行数值实验，以法国经济数据进行校准，模拟碳税和绿色企业劳动成本补贴两类气候政策对性别收入比的影响。
AI.findings: 碳税和绿色企业劳动成本补贴等气候政策均会降低男性对女性的收入比，即减少性别收入不平等；气候政策可同时实现碳减排和性别收入不平等的降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 将性别维度纳入环境宏观经济学分析框架，揭示了气候政策的性别分配效应，拓展了E-DSGE模型的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了气候政策可能带来"双重红利"（碳减排+性别收入平等）的证据，有助于设计兼顾公平与可持续的绿色政策。

title: Conjugate Bayesian Inference for Generalised Waring Distributions
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Conjugate Bayesian Inference for Generalised Waring Distributions
detail.abstract: The generalised Waring distribution GW(a, k; ρ) is the canonical model for accident and repeatevent counts, since it decomposes overdispersion into components attributable to randomness, proneness and liability. Its likelihood is a ratio of Pochhammer symbols in all three parameters, and this has kept full Bayesian inference out of reach. We provide a conjugate analysis. Our approach introduces a reciprocal gamma prior, the density proportional to a reciprocal Pochhammer symbol, which is the natural conjugate object for the gamma ratios appearing in the likelihood. We then construct a Pólya-Gamma style data augmentation scheme: a beta latent variable linearises the Pochhammer symbol in the denominator into an exponential tilt, and a Chinese restaurant table latent variable linearises the Pochhammer symbol in the numerator into a power. Conditional on the two latents, all three parameters have gamma or reciprocal gamma complete conditionals, and the sampler is a three-block Gibbs scheme with no Metropolis steps and no tuning. For the Waring sub-family with k = 1 we obtain the marginal posterior in closed form as a finite sum of residues, and we verify this representation to 120 digits. We also establish a fact that conditions any Bayesian treatment of this model. The GW likelihood is exactly symmetric under a ↔ k, so a and k are individually unidentified: only ρ and symmetric functions of (a, k) are estimable. Marginal posteriors for a and k are therefore bimodal, and the slow mixing reported for this model is a symptom of the symmetry rather than of the algorithm. We report inference for identified functionals throughout. We show that the conditional for the tail parameter is log-concave, so the sampler is exact without augmentation, and that the identification failure is confined to the intercept-only, single-period case: covariates break the symmetry, and so does replication. With J = 300 individuals observed T = 5 times each, proneness and liability separate cleanly, whereas at T = 1 they do not. The reason is transparent in the bivariate model, where the cross-margin covariance is shown to equal the proneness component of the variance exactly, annihilating the randomness and liability components. Covariates break the symmetry too, and conditionally on the two latent variables the regression likelihood is exactly that of a Poisson log-linear model, so a generalised Waring regression is no harder to fit than a Poisson one. Applied to the Greenwood and Yule accident data, the posterior places essentially all mass on ρ > 2, and attributes roughly 47% of the variance to randomness, with the remainder split between liability and proneness in a ratio the single-period counts cannot determine.

AI.tldr: 本文为广义Waring分布GW(a,k;ρ)提供了完整的贝叶斯推断方案。通过引入倒数伽马先验和Pólya-Gamma风格的数据增广方案（beta潜变量+中国餐馆桌子潜变量），构建了三块Gibbs采样器，无需Metropolis步骤和调参。同时发现GW似然在a↔k下具有精确对称性，导致a和k无法单独识别，只能估计ρ和对称函数，这一发现解释了该模型采样慢混合的根源。文章还证明了协变量可以打破对称性，使广义Waring回归与泊松对数线性回归一样易于拟合。
AI.research_question: 如何为广义Waring分布GW(a,k;ρ)提供完整的贝叶斯推断？该模型的参数可识别性如何？
AI.motivation: 广义Waring分布是事故和重复事件计数的典范模型，能将其过离散分解为随机性、倾向性和责任性三个来源。但其似然函数是三个参数的Pochhammer符号之比，使得全贝叶斯推断一直无法实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共轭贝叶斯分析、Pólya-Gamma数据增广、中国餐馆过程、参数可识别性理论、泊松对数线性模型
AI.method: 1) 引入比例于倒数Pochhammer符号的倒数伽马先验作为自然共轭对象；2) 构建beta潜变量将分母Pochhammer符号线性化为指数倾斜；3) 构建中国餐馆桌子潜变量将分子Pochhammer符号线性化为幂；4) 基于两个潜变量设计三块Gibbs采样器；5) 对k=1的Waring子族，用留数定理得到边际后验闭式解并验证到120位精度；6) 通过双变量模型和模拟（J=300，T=5）分析参数可识别性。
AI.findings: 1) GW似然在a↔k下精确对称，a和k个体不可识别，仅ρ和a,k的对称函数可估；2) 边际后验双峰，慢混合源于对称性而非算法；3) 尾部参数条件分布对数凹，无需增广即可精确采样；4) 识别失败仅限截距项、单周期情形，协变量和重复观测均可打破对称性；5) 在J=300、T=5时倾向性和责任性可清晰分离，T=1时不可；6) 双变量模型中交叉边际协方差恰好等于方差中倾向性分量；7) 条件于两个潜变量，回归似然恰为泊松对数线性模型；8) 应用于Greenwood-Yule事故数据，后验将几乎全部质量置于ρ>2，约47%方差归因于随机性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次为广义Waring分布提供完整共轭贝叶斯推断框架；2) 发现并严格证明GW模型的a↔k对称性及其对可识别性的根本影响，这是任何贝叶斯处理该模型的先决条件；3) 建立了过离散分解成分与样本量、观测次数之间的可识别性条件；4) 揭示了潜变量条件下GW回归与泊松回归的等价性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了完全无调参、无Metropolis步骤的三块Gibbs采样器，极大降低了贝叶斯推断的计算门槛；2) 澄清了该模型慢混合的真实原因（参数对称性而非算法缺陷），指导实践者正确使用模型；3) 证明广义Waring回归不比泊松回归更难拟合，为事故数据分析提供了实用工具；4) 对Greenwood-Yule经典数据给出了明确的方差分解结果（约47%随机性）及ρ>2的后验结论。

title: New Green Alliances: Requirements to Implement Long-run International Sustainable Energy Partnerships
affiliations: RWTH Aachen University and RWTH Aachen University

detail.title: New Green Alliances: Requirements to Implement Long-run International Sustainable Energy Partnerships
detail.abstract: International renewable energy partnerships are increasingly promoted to enhance energy security, accelerate decarbonization, and mobilize private capital for large-scale cross-border infrastructure. Their long-run viability, however, depends on whether cooperation between heterogeneous governments and private investors is incentive-compatible under realistic market and policy conditions. This paper develops a tripartite evolutionary game-theoretical model to analyze the dynamic stability of international sustainable energy partnerships. The framework captures strategic interaction between energy-importing governments, energy-exporting governments, and private sector investors, with payoffs incorporating net present values of infrastructure investments, carbon pricing, transaction costs, and alternative public–private partnership remuneration schemes. The model is calibrated to a prospective renewable hydrogen partnership between the European Union and North African countries and used to examine how energy prices, levelized production costs, capital costs, and institutional design parameters affect equilibrium selection. The results show that under incomplete pricing of environmental externalities, private investment is not incentive-compatible at scale. Improvements in technology costs or energy prices alone are insufficient to generate dynamically stable cooperation. Instead, institutional design critically shapes long-run outcomes. In particular, joint public co-investment reduces asymmetric windfall gains and strengthens governments’ commitment incentives, while availability-based public–private partnerships improve private risk allocation and enhance stability relative to concession models. The findings highlight that the success of international sustainable energy partnerships depends less on technological progress alone than on incentive-compatible institutional design and coordinated public investment structures.

AI.tldr: 本文构建三方演化博弈模型分析国际可持续能源伙伴关系的动态稳定性，以欧盟-北非可再生氢伙伴关系为案例，发现仅靠技术进步或能源价格改善不足以维持稳定合作，激励相容的制度设计和公共联合投资才是关键。
AI.research_question: 在现实市场和政策条件下，国际可持续能源伙伴关系中的异质性政府与私人投资者之间的合作是否激励相容？制度设计如何影响合作的长周期稳定性？
AI.motivation: 国际可再生能源伙伴关系被广泛推广以增强能源安全、加速脱碳和调动私人资本，但其长期可行性取决于激励相容性，而现有研究对此缺乏动态演化视角的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三方演化博弈理论（tripartite evolutionary game theory），结合基础设施投资净现值、碳定价、交易成本及公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）报酬机制等概念框架。
AI.method: 构建三方演化博弈模型，将能源进口国政府、能源出口国政府和私人投资者纳入博弈框架，并以欧盟与北非国家之间的可再生氢伙伴关系进行参数校准，模拟分析能源价格、平准化生产成本、资本成本和制度设计参数对均衡选择的影响。
AI.findings: （1）在环境外部性定价不完整时，私人投资在大规模上不具备激励相容性；（2）仅改善技术成本或能源价格不足以产生动态稳定的合作；（3）联合公共共同投资能减少不对称意外收益并强化政府承诺激励；（4）基于可用性的公私伙伴关系比特许经营模式更能改善私人风险分配并增强稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将演化博弈理论拓展至国际可持续能源伙伴关系领域，揭示了激励相容的制度设计相比技术进步的相对重要性，并为公私伙伴关系中的制度设计选择提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际可再生能源合作伙伴关系的政策设计提供指导，包括公共联合投资机制和PPP模式选择（可用性付费优于特许经营），有助于提升跨国产能合作的长期可行性与投资吸引力。

title: An Optimal Energy Production Problem with Energy Source Switching and Load Following Nuclear Power Plants
affiliations: University of Verona - University of Verona,  and University of Verona - Department of Economics

detail.title: An Optimal Energy Production Problem with Energy Source Switching and Load Following Nuclear Power Plants
detail.abstract: The integration of weather-dependent renewable generation increases the volatility of residual demand and raises the value of dispatchable low-carbon flexibility. This paper studies the optimal operation of a load-following nuclear power plant owned by a producer that must balance stochastic residual demand while accounting for ramping limits and costly changes in operating regimes. Nuclear output can be increased, decreased, or kept constant, and the production decision is formulated as a finite-horizon optimal switching problem. We analyze both a closed-economy benchmark, where excess production cannot be sold and shortages require costly back-up generation, and an open-economy setting, where the producer can trade electricity at prices driven by aggregate market residual demand. The value functions are characterized as viscosity solutions of a system of Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman quasi-variational inequalities, and optimal policies are computed using a monotone semi-Lagrangian scheme. The numerical results show how shortage costs, switching costs, ramping capability, and market access shape optimal nuclear load following. The analysis highlights the economic value of controllable low-carbon capacity in renewable-intensive systems and provides implications for flexibility remuneration, balancing-market design, and interconnection policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个负荷跟踪核电站的最优运行问题。该电站由生产者拥有，必须在考虑爬坡限制和运行状态转换成本的前提下平衡随机剩余需求。论文将生产决策建模为有限时域最优切换问题，分别分析了封闭经济（过剩无法出售、短缺需昂贵的备用发电）和开放经济（可在市场中交易）两种情境。通过HJB拟变分不等式的粘性解刻画价值函数，并采用单调半拉格朗日格式计算最优策略，揭示了短缺成本、切换成本、爬坡能力和市场准入对核负荷跟踪的影响。
AI.research_question: 在可再生能源渗透率提高导致剩余需求波动加剧的背景下，具有爬坡限制和运行状态切换成本的负荷跟踪核电站应如何最优运行？
AI.motivation: 随着天气依赖型可再生能源的大规模接入，剩余需求的波动性显著增加，这提升了可调度低碳灵活性资源的价值。核电站作为可调度的低碳电源，其在负荷跟踪模式下如何最优运行是一个重要且尚未充分研究的问题，对于理解可控低碳容量在可再生能源密集型系统中的经济价值具有关键意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优切换问题（Optimal Switching Problem）；Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman拟变分不等式（HJB-QVI）；粘性解理论；动态规划。
AI.method: 将核电站生产决策建模为有限时域最优切换问题，利用HJB拟变分不等式的粘性解刻画价值函数，采用单调半拉格朗日数值格式计算最优策略，并对封闭经济与开放经济两种情境进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 数值结果揭示了短缺成本、切换成本、爬坡能力及市场准入如何影响核电站的最优负荷跟踪策略。负荷跟踪核电站能够提供显著的经济价值：封闭经济中通过灵活调峰避免高额短缺成本，开放经济中通过市场交易优化收益。核电站的灵活运行能力在可再生能源密集型系统中具有重要的经济意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 将最优切换问题的理论框架应用于核电站负荷跟踪场景，通过HJB拟变分不等式的粘性解为核电站灵活运行提供了严格的理论刻画，填补了核电机组运行优化与切换控制理论之间的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为核电站运营者提供了最优负荷跟踪策略的计算框架；为政策制定者提供了关于灵活性报酬机制（flexibility remuneration）、平衡市场设计和互联互通政策（interconnection policy）的启示，强调了可控低碳容量在可再生能源系统中的经济价值。

title: The Thorin Measure of the Riemann Zeta Function
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Thorin Measure of the Riemann Zeta Function
detail.abstract: The completed Riemann zeta function, read as a function of v = s(1-s), is entire of order one half and so has a Hadamard product of genus zero. Its zero measure U ζ , the pushforward of the zeros under ρ → ρ(1-ρ), is a Thorin measure, equivalently 1/(2Ω(-s)) is the Laplace transform of a generalised gamma convolution, precisely when the Riemann hypothesis holds. The defect from Thorin's class is then not an obstruction but a number, the Krein-Langer index κ, and we prove a signature count showing that κ is exactly the number of negative eigenvalues of the associated Hankel matrices, and that these are built from the cumulants of the underlying gamma convolution. A recent paper attributed to a large language model developed at Anthropic proves unconditionally that at least 2 3 of the zeros of ζ in a dyadic window lie on the critical line, that at least 2 3 are simple and on the line, and that at least 5 6 are distinct. Translated: at least two thirds of the localised Thorin mass is carried by the positive real axis, at least two thirds of it consists of unit atoms, and the Krein-Langer defect is at most one sixth, against seven twenty-fourths from the previous unconditional record. The mechanism of that proof, a finite compression of Weil's Hermitian form together with two trace moments, Sylvester's law of inertia and a rank-trace inequality, is the indefinite truncated Stieltjes moment problem for the same measure. We record the dictionary, identify where it is exact and where it fails, compare it with Li's criterion, note a reading of the certificate in terms of effective dimension familiar from shrinkage, and set out twelve open problems. An appendix records an independent check of every constant asserted here, including four errors it turned up in our own first draft.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了完备黎曼zeta函数在变换 v = s(1-s) 下的零点测度 U_ζ。该测度是Thorin测度（等价于其拉普拉斯变换为广义伽马卷积）当且仅当黎曼假设成立。作者证明了Krein-Langer指标κ恰好等于相关Hankel矩阵负特征值的个数，这些矩阵由底层伽马卷积的累积量构建。文章进一步分析了由Anthropic大型语言模型协助得到的零点的无条件结果——即至少2/3的零点在临界线上、至少2/3简单且在线上、至少5/6互异——并将其翻译为Thorin测度的语言。作者将该证明机制（Weil厄米形式的有限压缩、两个迹矩、Sylvester惯性定律和秩-迹不等式）识别为不定截断Stieltjes矩问题，并与Li准则比较，最后列出了十二个开放问题。
AI.research_question: 如何用Thorin测度和广义伽马卷积的语言理解黎曼zeta函数零点的分布？Krein-Langer指标如何量化从Thorin类测度的偏离，以及它与Hankel矩阵负特征值有何精确关系？Anthropic语言模型辅助的零点无条件结果如何在测度论的框架下被解释和推广？
AI.motivation: 黎曼假设虽未证明，但已有一系列无条件结果可用测度论语言重新表述。作者希望：(1) 将Krein-Langer缺陷指数κ解释为可计算的数值而非纯粹障碍；(2) 建立从一个LLM辅助证明（关于零点位于临界线、简单性和互异性的无条件结果）到不定截断Stieltjes矩问题之间的精确对应； (3) 通过签名计数定理给出κ与Hankel矩阵负特征值之间的等价关系，揭示潜在的伽马卷积累积量的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: Thorin测度理论、广义伽马卷积（generalised gamma convolution）、Hadamard乘积理论、Krein-Langer指标、Hankel矩阵与矩问题、Sylvester惯性定律、Weil厄米形式、不定截断Stieltjes矩问题、Li准则、有效维度/收缩（shrinkage）概念
AI.method: (1) 证明签名计数定理：κ等于相关Hankel矩阵负特征值的个数，这些矩阵由底层伽马卷积的累积量构造。(2) 分析LLM（Anthropic）证明中的机制——包括Weil厄米形式的有限压缩、两个迹矩、Sylvester惯性定律和秩-迹不等式——并将其识别为不定截断Stieltjes矩问题。(3) 构建精确的"词典"（dictionary），说明测度论语言与零点性质之间的翻译何时精确、何时失效。(4) 与Li准则比较并给出有效维度的物理解读。(5) 附录中对所有断言的常数进行独立校验，发现并纠正了初稿中的四处错误。
AI.findings: (1) 证明了Krein-Langer指标κ恰好等于由伽马卷积累积量构建的Hankel矩阵负特征值个数。(2) 将LLM辅助证明的无条件结果翻译为测度论语言：至少三分之二的局部Thorin质量由正实轴承载，至少三分之二由单位原子构成，Krein-Langer缺陷至多为六分之一（优于此前无条件记录的二十四分之七）。(3) 识别出LLM证明机制本质上是不定截断Stieltjes矩问题。(4) 建立了精确的翻译词典，识别了精确等价与失效之处。(5) 通过有效维度/收缩概念给出证明的解读，并与Li准则进行了比较。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 建立了Krein-Langer指标与Hankel矩阵负特征值之间的精确等价（签名计数定理），深化了黎曼zeta零点测度偏离Thorin类的理解。(2) 将不定截断Stieltjes矩问题作为统一框架，连接了Weil形式压缩、迹矩、Sylvester惯性定律和秩-迹不等式，为分析数论提供了新的测度论工具。(3) 给出了Thorin测度语言与零点性质之间翻译的精确边界（何处精确、何处失效），推动了Thorin类理论在黎曼假设问题上的应用。(4) 通过Li准则和有效维度概念建立了与概率统计理论的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供了可计算的方法来评估黎曼zeta零点偏离临界线的程度（通过Hankel矩阵和Krein-Langer指标）。(2) 独立验证了LLM辅助证明中所有常数，发现并纠正了初稿中的四处错误，为AI辅助数学研究提供了可复现性样例。(3) 列出了十二个开放问题，为后续研究指明了方向。（4）所建立的词典和框架可为AI辅助证明在数论中的应用提供方法论参考。

title: Incentives to Expand Transmission Capacity for Cross-Border Electricity Trade in Europe
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Groningen, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Incentives to Expand Transmission Capacity for Cross-Border Electricity Trade in Europe
detail.abstract: To what extent are incentives to expand transmission capacity for cross-border electricity trade aligned between countries? We address this question within the context of realizing the vision of a climate-neutral Europe by 2050. We compare two scenarios using a large-scale optimization model of the European electricity system (COMPETES). The first is based on the projected transmission capacity for 2030 (Base Grid); the second the capacity optimized for 2050 (Expanded Grid).We find that the expansion of transmission capacity reduces average electricity prices by 2.7% in 2050, but that the benefits are unevenly distributed. Transmission expansion stimulates renewable investment in the periphery and discourages nuclear investment across Europe: in Norway, offshore wind capacity increases sevenfold; in Spain, solar capacity doubles. Yet where prices in Spain fall by 14%, they rise by 19% in Norway. This country-level misalignment — Norway hosts more generation capacity yet faces higher prices — may hinder efficient transmission expansion and Europe achieving its decarbonization goals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧洲跨境电力贸易输电容量扩张激励在国家间的对齐程度。通过对比2030年基准电网与2050年优化扩容电网两种情景，发现输电扩容虽能整体降低平均电价2.7%，但收益分配不均，导致国家间激励错位，可能阻碍欧洲实现脱碳目标。
AI.research_question: 各国扩大跨境电力贸易输电容量的激励在多大程度上是一致的？
AI.motivation: 在2050年实现气候中性欧洲的背景下，跨境输电基础设施扩张是实现脱碳目标的关键，但各国间激励是否对齐尚不清楚，这可能阻碍效率最优的输电扩张。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧洲电力系统的大规模优化模型（COMPETES），通过情景对比分析输电容量扩张对各国电价、可再生能源投资及核电投资的影响。
AI.method: 使用COMPETES大规模优化模型对欧洲电力系统进行模拟，对比2030年预期输电容量（基准电网）与2050年优化输电容量（扩容电网）两种情景。
AI.findings: 输电扩容使2050年平均电价下降2.7%，但收益分配不均：输电扩张刺激外围地区可再生能源投资（挪威海上风电增7倍，西班牙太阳能增1倍），同时抑制欧洲核电投资；西班牙电价下降14%，而挪威电价上升19%。挪威虽承载更多发电容量却面临更高电价，存在国家层面的激励错位。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了输电基础设施扩张中国家间激励错位的机制——发电容量增加国未必是电价受益国，这种分配不均可能阻碍帕累托最优的输电扩张，为能源政策与基础设施投资理论提供了新的实证视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲输电基础设施投资决策提供政策参考，指出需要设计补偿机制或协调框架来缓解国家间的激励错位，以确保输电扩张能顺利推进并支撑2050年脱碳目标的实现。

title: Measuring 5G+ Broadband Networks -Emerging Technical and Policy Challenges
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL), Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, Technische Universität Berlin (TU Berlin) and University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB)

detail.title: Measuring 5G+ Broadband Networks -Emerging Technical and Policy Challenges
detail.abstract: 5G and beyond (5G+) networks promise to support a broad range of heterogeneous services, from enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB) to ultra-reliable low-latency communications (URLLC) and massive IoT. Realizing this promise depends on the ability of ecosystem stakeholders (mobile network operators, regulators, content/application providers, and end-users) to make evidence-based decisions, which in turn, requires meaningful measurements. However, collecting, interpreting, and comparing relevant data is complex. Answering pressing entrepreneurial and policy questions requires multiple metrics from multiple vantage points. This paper makes the case for a multi-stakeholder measurement ecosystem for 5G+ networks, examining how technical, economic, and governance challenges translate into measurement needs. We assess and compare the predominant measurement methodologies (unattended probes, drive tests, and crowdsourced approaches), analyzing their trade-offs in controllability, spatio-temporal resolution, scalability, cost, and data trustworthiness. We show how contextual factors, including indoor versus outdoor environments, device heterogeneity, and environmental conditions, fundamentally challenge metric interpretability, and how the coexistence of "competing" definitions and metrics for 5G and service performance and measurement approaches yield divergent coverage and performance assessments, posing additional challenges for policymaking. We conclude by reviewing emerging measurement paradigms and derive implications for evidence-based broadband policy. Those include hybrid data collection via UAV and satellite vantage points; and, AI/ML-driven analytics such as NWDAF-enabled data fusion and predictive optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了5G+网络需要建立多利益相关方测量生态系统，分析了技术、经济和治理挑战如何转化为测量需求，比较了三种主流测量方法（无人值守探针、路测、众包）的权衡，并探讨了新兴测量范式（如无人机/卫星混合数据收集和AI/ML驱动的分析）对未来宽带政策的影响。
AI.research_question: 5G+网络如何建立有效的多利益相关方测量生态系统以支持循证决策？技术、经济和治理挑战如何转化为测量需求，以及现有测量方法的权衡和新兴范式的政策启示是什么？
AI.motivation: 5G+网络承诺支持从eMBB到URLLC和物联网的异构服务，但实际兑现这一承诺依赖于生态系统中各利益相关方（运营商、监管者、内容/应用提供商、终端用户）进行基于证据的决策，而这需要有意义的测量。然而，收集、解释和比较相关数据非常复杂，亟需系统地分析和推动多利益相关方测量生态系统的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文采用多利益相关方视角，整合技术测量理论、经济学与治理框架，分析5G+网络测量生态系统的需求与挑战。
AI.method: 本文为综述性/概念性研究，系统评估和比较了三种主要的测量方法论（无人值守探针、路测、众包方法），分析其在可控性、时空分辨率、可扩展性、成本和数据可信度方面的权衡，并审查了新兴的测量范式。
AI.findings: 1) 5G+网络测量需要多指标、多视角的综合方法；2) 三种主流测量方法在可控性、时空分辨率、可扩展性、成本和数据可信度方面存在显著权衡；3) 室内外环境、设备异质性和环境条件等情境因素从根本上挑战了指标的可解释性；4) 共存"竞争性"定义和指标导致覆盖率和性能评估产生分歧结果，为政策制定带来额外挑战；5) 新兴范式包括无人机/卫星视角的混合数据收集和AI/ML驱动的分析（如NWDAF支持的数据融合和预测优化）。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文构建了多利益相关方测量生态系统的理论框架，系统阐明了技术、经济和治理挑战如何转化为具体的测量需求，并揭示了情境因素对指标可解释性的根本性挑战，丰富了5G网络测量领域的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文为宽带政策制定者提供了循证政策的测量方法选择指南，分析了不同测量方法的权衡（可控性、时空分辨率、可扩展性、成本和数据可信度），并提出了基于无人机/卫星混合数据收集和AI/ML驱动分析的新兴测量范式，为实际政策制定和网络测量实践提供指导。

title: Introducing Economic Disparity and Housing Immobility to Schelling's Dynamic Model of Segregation

detail.title: Introducing Economic Disparity and Housing Immobility to Schelling's Dynamic Model of Segregation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: Drawing on Thomas Schelling's 1971 dynamic model of racial segregation, this paper reexamines the model by introducing economic constraints that reflect modern limitations on wealth-driven sorting. Though Schelling's model effectively introduces segregation patterns influenced by social preference, it fails to account for real-world housing market patterns driven by financial mobility. To bridge said gap, the standard model was modified to mimic a city scaled by property values based on proximity to the geometrical center, with two agent groups assigned varying degrees of income disparity. As a result, this introduced an agent state of "trapped," in which the agent's desire to relocate based on social preference is inhibited by a lack of purchasing power. Running 2000 simulations across a control group and three economic disparity levels (low, medium and high) with varying social preference thresholds, the model deduces three key findings: (1) Income disparity drove spatial economic sorting, (2) interestingly, increased income disparity reduced overall social segregation by inhibiting feedback loops based on social preference, and (3) high income disparity led to housing friction which made 12% of agents "trapped." Ultimately, these findings suggest that economic disparity successfully influences segregation patterns and, crucially, incorporates financial constraints into urban sociological models.

AI.tldr: 本文在Schelling（1971）种族隔离动态模型的基础上，引入经济约束以反映现代财富驱动分层的限制。通过将城市按到几何中心的距离按房价比例缩放，并为两组代理分配不同程度的收入差距，模型引入"被困"（trapped）状态，即代理因购买力不足而无法根据社会偏好迁移。基于2000次模拟（对照组+低/中/高三个经济差距水平，不同社会偏好阈值），得出三个关键发现：收入差距驱动空间经济分层；收入差距增大反而通过抑制社会偏好反馈回路降低了整体社会隔离；高收入差距导致住房摩擦使12%的代理"被困"。
AI.research_question: 在Schelling种族隔离模型中引入经济约束后，收入差距如何影响空间分层、社会隔离以及住房摩擦中的"被困"状态？
AI.motivation: Schelling模型有效捕捉了由社会偏好驱动的隔离模式，但未能解释现实中由金融流动性驱动的住房市场模式，即模型缺乏对经济约束（购买力限制）的考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: Schelling（1971）动态种族隔离模型；经济约束下的城市住房市场模型（基于到城市中心距离的房价梯度）。
AI.method: 基于代理的计算机模拟（ABM），对Schelling模型进行修改：城市按到几何中心距离缩放房价；两组代理具有不同收入差距；引入"被困"代理状态。运行2000次模拟，设置对照组及低、中、高三种经济差距水平，并变化社会偏好阈值。
AI.findings: （1）收入差距驱动空间经济排序；（2）收入差距增大反而降低整体社会隔离（通过抑制基于社会偏好的反馈回路）；（3）高收入差距导致住房摩擦，使12%的代理处于"被困"状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济约束（购买力/收入差距）纳入经典Schelling模型中，拓展了城市社会学模型的分析框架，揭示了经济因素对社会隔离的复杂非线性影响（收入差距增大反而降低社会隔离）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实城市中住房市场、收入分层与种族/社会隔离之间的互动提供建模依据，有助于城市规划和住房政策制定者识别经济约束导致的空间不平等与"被困"群体问题。

title: Implications of the EU CBAM on Ukraine’s economy and environment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Purdue University, Department of Agricultural Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN and National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine

detail.title: Implications of the EU CBAM on Ukraine’s economy and environment
detail.abstract: The European Union’s (EU) Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) began its paid phase in 2026. As exporters adjust to new regulations, many EU trading partners are concerned with the potential implications of the CBAM for their economies. Ukraine is one of the key EU’s trading partners with substantial exports of the CBAM-covered commodities, particularly steel.
